> Your subscriptions don't renew by default anymore.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vitest](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vitest-333333?style=flat-square) ![prava](https://img.shields.io/badge/prava-333333?style=flat-square) ![senso](https://img.shields.io/badge/senso-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Most people are paying for subscriptions they've forgotten, outgrown, or are quietly being overcharged for. Intara is an iMessage agent that watches your recurring subscriptions, decides whether each one is worth keeping, and takes action. It cancels, renegotiates, or issues a Prava payment mandate enforced at the card network level. It doesn't just tell you what to do. It does it for you.

Next, I am adding subscription discovery through forwarded receipts, expanding merchant cancellation coverage, and building a B2B version for managing team SaaS spend.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest integration challenge was Prava's mandate flow. The Visa VTS authentication step at `sbx.vts.auth.visa.com` was silently failing in Safari. Sessions were being created and appearing as "Pending", but the redirect never completed. I worked directly with the Prava team, sharing session IDs and request payloads to trace the issue. The root cause turned out to be browser specific. Completing the flow in Chrome worked, giving us our first **Authorized** mandate (`ord_01KZ27X6EX16C99K`).

I also ran into a `merchant_scope` validation error. The API only accepts `any` or `listed`, not `unlisted` as we initially assumed. The 400 response made the issue clear, and the fix was straightforward.

On the Linq side, I found that the `/messages/{id}/update` endpoint only supports `imessage_app` card messages. Plain text messages can't be edited after they're sent, so I changed the interaction model to send follow-up messages in the same conversation, preserving a natural chat experience.

The project is backed by 17 unit and integration tests covering the renewal ceiling guard, price change detection, and all three decision paths.

**Best Visa Intelligent Commerce Implementation**

Integrated Prava to issue recurring payment mandates authorized through Visa's card network. The system creates real mandate sessions through the Prava API, with the first successful authorization producing mandate `ord_01KZ27X6EX16C99K`. Each mandate is merchant scoped, capped at an approved amount, and valid for a single billing cycle. These constraints are enforced by the payment network itself, not by application logic.

**Most Startup-Ready Product**

Intara was designed as more than a hackathon project. The architecture is built for production, with a real database, live integrations, no hardcoded business logic, deterministic ceiling enforcement outside the model, and a complete audit trail that users can inspect. The business model is straightforward: Intara earns a percentage of the verified savings it generates for users.

Subscription management is a market worth more than $6 billion, but most products stop at visibility by tracking subscriptions or sending reminders. Intara is built for the execution layer, making and carrying out renewal decisions instead of leaving the final action to the user.

**OpenAI**

GPT-4o Structured Outputs powers the renewal reasoning agent. Every decision must conform to a strict JSON schema containing `decision`, `reasoning_summary`, and `confidence`, ensuring predictable, machine-readable responses. The model runs at a temperature of `0.2` because renewal decisions require consistency over creativity. Critical safety checks, including renewal ceiling enforcement, are implemented in application code after every model response rather than delegated to the model itself.

**iMessage Agent**

iMessage is Intara's entire interface. Cards delivered via the Linq Partner API to a real phone number, typing indicators fire before reasoning begins, approval links sent as separate link parts per Linq's spec. The iMessage thread is the product.

**Agent Commerce Discovery & Trust**

Merchant intelligence for all three demo merchants is ingested into Senso's knowledge base. Used `POST /org/kb/raw` to ingest merchant data and `POST /org/search` to retrieve relevant context before every reasoning call. Information such as cancellation difficulty, price increase history, renegotiation opportunities, and current market pricing is injected into the OpenAI prompt, and the reasoning behind each decision is surfaced on every outcome card.

> Agentic Payments, the future is here

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Our prototype, Cart Blanche, solves the critical security and logistical barriers of allowing AI agents to make online purchases autonomously. In the AI era, agents often need to procure items across multiple websites to complete a single task (a 1-to-many relationship). Giving an AI raw credit card details poses a catastrophic financial risk, and manually entering payment info on every site defeats the purpose of an autonomous agent.

Cart Blanche bridges this gap by acting as a secure financial perimeter. It aggregates the AI's multi-merchant purchase intent into a "Universal Cart" and pauses for a single, unphishable biometric authorization from the human user via Prava Payments. Once approved, the system provisions constrained, single-use, merchant-locked virtual cards. This empowers the AI to safely complete transactions across various sites without ever exposing your primary financial instruments or risking unauthorized overspending.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building integrating Prava and tackling the issues with the sandbox environment was the main thing, we were trying to properly integrate Prava and add virtual payment cards but were unable to test end to end as the payments were failing in sandbox, hence our prototype is not 100% production ready and getting an error is normal.

**Best Visa Intelligent Commerce Implementation**

We are using PRava and unleashing the power of Visa to give the users the most secure and safe shopping eperience they can think of.

**OpenAI**

We are using OpenAI for product hunt across websites.

> It's my portfolio. It's also a star system. Go fly

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Most developer portfolios are a scroll and a sigh, it's a wall of text and screenshots that every recruiter has seen a thousand times. They're forgettable, and worse, they tell you someone can build things instead of showing it.

The Citadel System turns a résumé into a place you explore. Each part of my portfolio is a world in a 3D star system: planets are sections (About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Education), their moons are individual entries, and a station holds contact info. You drag to orbit the system, click a world to autopilot there, or take manual control of a ship and fly — then "scan" a body to open its dossier.

What people can use it for / why it's better:

Recruiters & visitors spend minutes engaging instead of seconds skimming — the content is the same, but it's discovered, not dumped. The medium itself is the strongest line on the résumé: it proves real‑time graphics, performance, and UX skill rather than claiming it.
It's a reusable template. All content lives in a single bodies.js file (one source of truth that drives both the 3D scene and the UI), so any developer can fork it, swap in their own data, and ship their own explorable portfolio without touching the engine.
Accessibility & polish without bloat: a quest‑style objectives tracker turns "read my portfolio" into a light game loop (scan all 6 worlds), a post‑load screen guarantees nothing pops in unfinished, and a hidden retro "pixel mode" rewards curiosity.
It makes the boring, high‑stakes task of getting someone to actually look at your work genuinely fun.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I ran into
1. The loading screen that hung forever (the nastiest one).
After pressing ENTER, a loading bar holds the system until every asset is ready, then fades out. In testing it would sometimes freeze at 0% and never dismiss, trapping the user on a blank screen. I'd built the progress loop on requestAnimationFrame,  which the browser pauses entirely in a backgrounded/inactive tab. If you alt‑tabbed during the (multi‑MB) load, rAF stopped, the bar never advanced, and the "ready" check never fired. The fix was to drive the loader with setInterval instead (timers keep firing when hidden) and to complete as soon as assets are ready past a minimum display time. Now it's bulletproof even if you tab away mid‑load.

2. A 125 MB ship that rendered as a glowing white blob.
The ship model was ~125 MB and almost entirely emissive. Draco compression got the download down to ~6.5 MB, but the bigger problem was visual: under the bloom post‑processing pass, the self‑lit hull blew out into a featureless white smear. The answer was counter‑intuitive, to lower the emissive intensity dramatically (0.12) and lean on a hemisphere fill + a camera‑side rim light instead, so the engines glow and bloom subtly without the whole ship turning into a star.

3. "More color" that tanked the framerate.
To make space feel alive I rewrote the nebula as a domain‑warped fractal‑noise shade, and the system started lurching. The shader was running 8 fractal‑noise taps per pixel, full‑screen, every frame. I cut it back to 3 taps × 4 octaves, reusing those same noise fields to drive the multi‑region coloring, which restored the framerate below the original cost while keeping the richer look. Lesson re‑learned: on a full‑screen shader, every extra fbm() call is multiplied by millions of pixels.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was designing a recommendation system that generated realistic and meaningful career suggestions instead of generic results. We also had to balance the career readiness scoring logic so that factors such as skills, CGPA, projects, certifications, and career interests contributed fairly to the final recommendations.

Another challenge was integrating the FastAPI backend with the frontend while ensuring smooth API communication and a responsive user experience. We also worked on integrating the AI Career Coach, making sure it generated relevant, well-formatted responses based on each user's assessment.

We addressed these challenges by refining the scoring algorithm, testing with different user profiles, improving API integration, and iteratively validating both the recommendation system and AI responses until they produced reliable and personalized results.

**The problem it solves**

Career guidance is often based on generic advice, online trends, or personal opinions rather than a student's actual skills and capabilities. As a result, many students invest time learning technologies that may not align with their strengths or industry requirements.

Career Compass AI solves this by analyzing a student's technical skills, academic performance, projects, certifications, and career interests to provide personalized career recommendations, readiness analysis, learning roadmaps, and AI-powered career guidance.

Users can:

Discover the most suitable technology career paths.
Measure their career readiness based on their profile.
Identify the skills required for their target career.
Follow a personalized learning roadmap with recommended certifications and projects.
Explore different technology careers through the Career Explorer.
Receive personalized career guidance, project ideas, interview tips, and skill recommendations through the AI Career Coach.

The platform transforms scattered career information into personalized, actionable guidance, helping students make informed career decisions and prepare confidently for future opportunities.

### Jeebika
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/jeebika-cc31) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/rupam2232/Jeebika) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HexaFalls%202-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hexafalls2.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Opportunity Within Reach

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Understanding the Real Problem

Challenge: Initially, we planned to build a generic job portal. However, after researching the daily wage workforce, we realized that their challenges are very different from traditional job seekers. The real issues were trust, accessibility, payment verification, and dependence on middlemen.

Solution: We redesigned our platform to focus on solving these core problems rather than simply listing jobs.

2. Designing for Low Digital Literacy

Challenge: Many daily wage workers are not comfortable using complex applications or filling long forms.

Solution: We designed a simple, intuitive, and mobile-responsive interface with minimal steps and incorporated AI-powered voice interaction to make the platform more accessible.

3. Building an Efficient Job Matching System

Challenge: Matching workers with employers required considering multiple factors such as skills, availability, and location.

Solution: We implemented an AI-assisted location-based matching system that recommends nearby workers based on skill sets and availability, reducing hiring time for employers.

4. Verifying Cash Payments

Challenge: Most daily wage workers still receive payments in cash, making payment disputes difficult to resolve.

Solution: We introduced an OTP-based payment verification system, where the worker confirms cash receipt using a one-time password, creating a digital proof of payment.

5. Integrating AI Effectively

Challenge: We wanted AI to provide real value instead of acting as a simple chatbot.

Solution: We integrated Google Gemini to understand natural language, extract structured job details, and assist with intelligent job matching and worker registration.

6. Creating a Scalable Backend

Challenge: As multiple modules were involved, maintaining a clean and scalable backend architecture became challenging.

Solution: We adopted a modular architecture using Express.js with separate routes, controllers, services, and database models, making the application easier to maintain and extend.

7. Managing Limited Hackathon Time

Challenge: Implementing every planned feature within the hackathon timeframe was not feasible.

Solution: We focused on delivering a complete end-to-end workflow:
Worker Registration → Job Posting → AI Matching → Job Acceptance → OTP Payment Verification, ensuring a functional and demonstrable MVP.

8. Working Within Free-Tier Constraints

Challenge: We wanted to build a fully functional prototype while using only free or free-tier services.

Solution: We selected technologies with generous free tiers, including Vite + React, Tailwind CSS, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, Google Gemini API, Twilio for OTP services, Exotel for IVR, and Render for deployment.

**The problem it solves**

Jeebika – Opportunity within reach.

Problem Statement :

India's informal workforce forms the backbone of the economy. Millions of daily wage workers—including construction laborers, masons, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, painters, drivers, farm workers, and helpers—depend on finding work every day to earn their livelihood.

Despite their importance, most of these workers still rely on labor chowks, local contractors, or personal contacts to secure jobs. This traditional system is inefficient, unreliable, and often exploitative.

Workers face several challenges:

* No guarantee of finding work every day.
* Dependence on middlemen who charge commissions or reduce wages.
* Fake employers and fraudulent job offers.
* Cash payment disputes with no proof of payment.
* No verified work history or professional identity.
* Limited access to smartphones or digital payment systems.
* Low digital literacy, making existing job platforms difficult to use.
* Language barriers and complex application interfaces.
* No trusted way to build a reputation based on previous work.

Employers also face significant problems:

* Difficulty finding skilled workers on short notice.
* No reliable way to verify a worker's experience or trustworthiness.
* Time wasted searching through personal contacts.
* High dependency on contractors, increasing hiring costs.
* No transparent hiring or work-completion process.

Current online job platforms are designed primarily for educated, full-time job seekers. They require smartphones, internet access, literacy, and familiarity with digital applications—making them inaccessible for a large section of India's informal workforce.

As a result, millions of workers remain disconnected from employment opportunities despite the growing demand for skilled labor.

---

 Our Solution :

Jeebika is a voice-first, AI-powered employment platform designed specifically for India's informal workforce.

Instead of relying only on smartphones, Jeebika enables workers to access employment opportunities through multiple channels:

* PWA (Progressive Web App)
* Interactive Voice Response (IVR)
* SMS Notifications

Workers can register, search for nearby jobs, accept work, complete jobs, and verify payments using simple voice interactions or basic mobile phones.

Employers can quickly find nearby verified workers, post jobs using voice or text, and hire workers without intermediaries.

---

 What Problems Does Jeebika Solve?

 1. Eliminates Middlemen

Jeebika connects workers directly with employers, reducing dependency on contractors and ensuring workers receive fair wages.

---

 2. Makes Jobs Accessible to Everyone

Many workers do not own smartphones or have limited digital literacy.

Jeebika works through:

* Voice calls (IVR)
* SMS
* Android App

This allows both smartphone and feature phone users to participate equally.

---

 3. Helps Workers Find Nearby Jobs Faster

Using location-based matching and AI, workers receive relevant jobs near their current location, reducing travel time and increasing daily employment opportunities.

---

4. Supports Voice-Based Interaction

Workers do not need to type or navigate complicated interfaces.

They can simply speak commands such as:

* "I need work today."
* "I am a mason."
* "Accept this job."

The AI understands the request and performs the required action.

---

 5. Prevents Payment Fraud

Cash remains the preferred payment method for many daily wage workers.

Jeebika introduces an OTP-based payment verification system.

After receiving cash, the worker confirms payment using a secure OTP.

This creates proof that payment was completed and significantly reduces disputes between workers and employers.

---

 6. Builds Trust

Every completed job contributes to a worker's verified profile.

Workers gradually build:

* Employment history
* Ratings
* Reviews
* Completed jobs

Employers can confidently hire workers based on verified performance rather than personal recommendations.

---

 7. Helps Employers Hire Quickly

Employers can instantly find nearby workers based on:

* Skill
* Availability
* Distance
* Ratings

This reduces hiring time and improves productivity.

---

 8. Creates Transparency

Every job records:

* Worker acceptance
* Employer confirmation
* Job start
* Job completion
* Payment verification
* Ratings

This transparent workflow minimizes disputes and increases accountability.



 Key Features :

* Nearby job matching
* Android and feature phone support
* IVR-based interaction
* SMS notifications
* OTP-based job start verification
* OTP-based cash payment verification
* AI 
* Employer and worker ratings
* Complaint management system
* Secure authentication

Impact:

Jeebika empowers daily wage workers by making employment more accessible, transparent, and trustworthy.

For workers, it means more opportunities, fair wages, and a verified pro

**Best Use of MongoDB Atlas**

Challenge:
Since our application manages multiple types of data—including workers, employers, jobs, applications, ratings, and payment records—we needed a database that was flexible, scalable, and easy to integrate. Choosing the right data structure and designing efficient relationships in MongoDB Atlas was initially challenging.

Solution:
We designed a well-structured MongoDB Atlas database using separate collections for each entity (Users, Jobs, Applications, Payments, Ratings, and Complaints). By leveraging MongoDB's flexible document model, we efficiently handled dynamic worker profiles and job data while ensuring fast queries and scalability. Using MongoDB Atlas also allowed us to quickly deploy a cloud-hosted database with built-in security, backups, and monitoring, making it ideal for rapid hackathon development.

**Open Innovation**

Jeebika is an AI-powered employment platform designed for India's informal workforce. Millions of daily wage workers still rely on middlemen, face payment disputes, and lack a trusted work history. Jeebika connects workers directly with nearby employers using AI-assisted job matching, voice-enabled interaction, and OTP-based cash payment verification. By making employment more accessible, transparent, and trustworthy, Jeebika empowers workers to earn with dignity while helping employers hire skilled labor quickly. This combination of AI, accessibility, and social impact makes Jeebika a strong fit for the Open Innovation Track.

### D-E-A-D
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/deaddisease-early-alert-detection-80d6) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DEBMUKHERJEE15/DEAD-Frontend-.git) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/7QYk0JicQGY) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Citadel%20Hackathon%20--%20Season%201-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://citadel-hackathon.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Disease Early Alert Detection

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Disease outbreaks in rural and low-resource regions are often detected weeks too late because frontline clinics record patient symptoms as unstructured free-text notes that are never analyzed in real time. Most existing AI-powered surveillance systems require continuous internet connectivity and cloud infrastructure, making them unusable in remote areas where network outages are common.

As a result, health authorities receive outbreak information only after 14–28 days, allowing infectious diseases to spread before preventive action can be taken. The lack of early detection increases mortality, overwhelms healthcare systems, and delays the deployment of medicines, medical staff, and emergency resources.

Why existing solutions fall short

| Solution                                     | How it works                                                                            | Limitation                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Quantized Gemma 2B (4-bit GGUF)**          | Runs a Small Language Model locally for clinical note understanding                     | Only performs NLP extraction; without outbreak analytics it cannot identify disease spikes or regional trends                               |
| **Early Outbreak Disease Detection Systems** | Detect outbreaks using centralized surveillance and historical reporting                | Dependent on internet connectivity and delayed data aggregation, resulting in slow outbreak identification                                  |
| **Electronic Health Record (EHR) Analytics** | Analyzes structured digital medical records                                             | Rural clinics often lack standardized EHR systems, leaving unstructured clinical notes unused                                               |
| **DEAD **                                   | **Offline Edge AI + Local CUSUM Anomaly Detection + Privacy-Preserving Federated Sync** | **Works completely offline, detects outbreaks locally in real time, and securely synchronizes anonymized alerts when connectivity returns** |

How PacketForge fixes this

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/ac0909c626bd4261a16d44c83d4d1f22/9364ec20-c44f-4a37-b156-560fd9ce2b92.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

Building an offline AI-powered disease surveillance platform that works reliably in rural healthcare settings introduced several engineering challenges. The biggest challenge wasn't building the AI model itself—it was making the entire pipeline work without continuous internet connectivity, while remaining lightweight enough to run on ordinary clinic laptops.

Challenge 1 — Running an LLM Completely Offline on Low-End Hardware

Most modern medical NLP solutions rely on cloud-hosted Large Language Models that require GPUs and constant internet access. Rural health clinics often have only Intel i5 laptops with 8 GB RAM, making these approaches impractical.

Running the original Gemma model locally quickly exhausted memory and produced inference times that were too slow for real clinical workflows.

How we fixed it

We switched to a 4-bit quantized Gemma 2B (GGUF) model executed through llama.cpp, reducing memory consumption while maintaining useful medical reasoning.

Clinical Note
      │
      ▼
Gemma 2B (4-bit GGUF)
      │
      ▼
llama.cpp Runtime
      │
      ▼
Structured Medical JSON
Model	RAM Required	Internet	Clinic Ready
Full Gemma	16–24 GB	Optional	❌ No
Cloud LLM APIs	Cloud	Required	❌ No
Gemma 2B (4-bit GGUF) ✅	~4–5 GB	None	✅ Yes
Challenge 2 — Extracting Reliable Information from Messy Clinical Notes

Doctors and health workers rarely follow a fixed format while writing notes. Symptoms may be abbreviated, written in multiple languages, or described differently by different clinicians.

Examples:

"High fever + vomiting"

"Fever since 3 days"

"Loose motion with dehydration"

"Vomiting, diarrhea, weak"

A rule-based parser missed many medically equivalent descriptions and generated inconsistent outputs.

How we fixed it

Instead of keyword matching, we used the offline Small Language Model to perform semantic understanding, extracting structured information including:

Syndrome
Symptoms
Severity
ICD-10 Code
Confidence Score

This made the system far more robust across varying writing styles and languages.

Challenge 3 — Secure Synchronization Without Exposing Patient Data

The central dashboard needs outbreak information, but transmitting raw clinical notes raises serious privacy concerns and increases bandwidth requirements.

Sending full patient records would also violate healthcare privacy principles.

How we fixed it

Instead of synchronizing medical records, DEAD only uploads anonymous outbreak signals whenever connectivity becomes available.

Before transmission we apply:

SHA-256 hashing for clinic identifiers
Laplace Differential Privacy
Payload compression (~800 bytes)
Clinical Notes
      │
      ▼
AI Processing
      │
      ▼
Anonymous Alert Signal
      │
      ▼
Differential Privacy
      │
      ▼
Central Dashboard
Data Type	Uploaded
Patient Notes	❌ Never
Patient Identity	❌ Never
Alert Statistics	✅ Yes
Anonymous Metadata	✅ Yes
Challenge 4 — Supporting Clinics with Unreliable Internet

Many rural clinics experience intermittent connectivity, making cloud-first architectures unreliable.

If every clinical note required internet access, the system would simply stop working during outages.

How we fixed it

We designed the platform using an edge-first architecture.

AI inference runs entirely offline.
Alerts are generated locally.
Data is stored in SQLite until connectivity returns.
Secure synchronization happens automatically in the background.
SMS can be used as a fallback notification channel for prolonged outages.

This ensures that disease surveillance continues uninterrupted even when the clinic is completely offline.

**Challenges we ran into**

Integrating real-time updates across patient, receptionist, and doctor dashboards using Socket.IO.
Keeping queue information synchronized for all users without delays or inconsistencies.
Dynamically recalculating patient ETAs whenever emergencies, doctor breaks, or consultation completions occurred.
Managing different user roles (Patient, Receptionist, Doctor, and Admin) with secure authentication and authorization.
Designing an efficient queue algorithm that fairly handles normal and emergency patients.
Ensuring the system remained responsive while multiple users accessed it simultaneously.
Integrating QR code generation and status tracking for easy patient access.
Handling edge cases such as appointment cancellations, missed patients, doctor unavailability, and queue reordering.
Deploying the full-stack application with proper environment variables, database connectivity, and production configuration.
Providing a simple, intuitive interface that could be easily used by hospital staff with minimal training.

**The problem it solves**

Traditional hospital queue management systems are often manual, inefficient, and lack real-time communication, leading to long waiting times, overcrowded waiting areas, poor patient experience, and increased workload for hospital staff. Patients typically have no visibility into their queue position, estimated consultation time, or appointment status, resulting in uncertainty and unnecessary waiting. Receptionists must manually register patients, manage walk-ins, handle emergency cases, and coordinate with doctors, making the process slow and error-prone. Furthermore, there is no centralized mechanism to dynamically update queue priorities, recalculate waiting times, or instantly notify patients of changes. This project addresses these challenges by providing a smart digital hospital queue management system where patients can book appointments online, receive digital tokens, and monitor their live queue status through QR codes or status links. At the same time, receptionists, doctors, and administrators use dedicated dashboards to efficiently manage patient registration, emergency prioritization, consultation progress, doctor availability, and real-time ETA updates, resulting in reduced waiting time, improved operational efficiency, and a seamless hospital experience for both patients and healthcare staff.

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem It Solves

Students, developers, and professionals often juggle multiple responsibilities at the same time—exams, internships, hackathons, projects, courses, certifications, and personal goals. Traditional productivity tools typically rely on simple task lists, making it difficult to understand priorities, visualize progress, identify deadline conflicts, or see how different goals connect together.

## How NeuroCanvas AI Helps

NeuroCanvas AI acts as an AI-powered Visual Second Brain that transforms scattered thoughts and goals into structured, actionable roadmaps. Users can dump ideas in natural language, and the system automatically organizes them into visual nodes, milestones, and priority-based action plans.

### Key Benefits

* **AI Brain Dump:** Convert messy thoughts into organized goals and tasks.
* **Visual Roadmaps:** See how goals, projects, and milestones connect on an infinite canvas.
* **Smart Prioritization:** Automatically identify what should be done first.
* **Deadline Conflict Detection:** Detect overlapping deadlines before they become a problem.
* **Learning Path Generation:** Turn YouTube learning content into step-by-step roadmaps.
* **Progress Tracking:** Monitor goal completion, milestones, and productivity trends.
* **Burnout Risk Analysis:** Identify workload overload and improve planning decisions.

### Real-World Use Cases

* Students planning exams, projects, and internship preparation.
* Developers organizing learning paths and personal projects.
* Hackathon participants managing tasks, deadlines, and team goals.
* Professionals creating career roadmaps and skill-development plans.
* Anyone who wants to transform chaotic ideas into a clear, visual action plan.

By combining AI-powered planning with real-time visual organization, NeuroCanvas AI helps users make better decisions, stay focused, and achieve long-term goals more effectively.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges I Ran Into

One of the biggest challenges was designing a system where the visual canvas, AI-generated roadmaps, and analytics dashboard all stayed synchronized. Early in development, updates made in one part of the application (such as editing nodes on the canvas) were not automatically reflected in the dashboard, causing inconsistencies between the displayed analytics and the actual project data.

Another challenge was converting unstructured user input into meaningful visual roadmaps. Users can enter highly varied and messy text, so creating a reliable workflow for extracting goals, tasks, priorities, and milestones required multiple iterations of prompt engineering and data structuring.

To solve these issues, I redesigned the application architecture around a centralized state and database-driven workflow. Every action—such as creating, updating, or completing a node—updates the database and triggers recalculation of analytics and progress metrics. I also refined the AI processing pipeline to consistently transform natural-language input into structured roadmap data that could be visualized on the canvas.

Additionally, balancing feature richness with hackathon time constraints was a challenge. I prioritized the core user experience—AI Brain Dump, visual roadmap generation, progress tracking, and conflict detection—before moving on to advanced enhancements and UI polish.

**The problem it solves**

## What can people use SmartAg Ops for?

SmartAg Ops helps farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, and government agencies make smarter agricultural decisions using real-time market intelligence and AI-powered forecasting.

### For Farmers
- Find the **best mandi to sell crops** for maximum profit.
- Know the **best time to sell** using 1–7 day price forecasts.
- Receive AI recommendations such as **sell now, hold, or switch markets**.
- Understand risks from price volatility, weather changes, and sudden arrival spikes.
- Access explanations behind every recommendation to build trust and confidence.

### For FPOs & Cooperatives
- Compare multiple markets and identify the most profitable destinations.
- Optimize crop distribution and logistics using AI-driven planning.
- Monitor supply-demand conditions across regions.
- Reduce losses caused by oversupply, poor market selection, or transportation inefficiencies.

### For Government & Agricultural Authorities
- Monitor market health across districts and states through a centralized command center.
- Detect shortages, oversupply conditions, and price anomalies early.
- Receive AI-generated alerts for supply disruptions, weather impacts, and market risks.
- Support evidence-based policy decisions using real-time agricultural intelligence.

### How it makes existing processes easier
Traditional systems only display historical mandi prices, forcing users to manually analyze trends and make decisions. SmartAg Ops automates this process by combining live market data, forecasting models, risk analytics, and explainable AI into a single platform that delivers clear, actionable recommendations.

### How it improves safety and reliability
- Automated data validation and anomaly detection improve data quality.
- Risk monitoring identifies potential disruptions before they impact stakeholders.
- Explainable AI ensures recommendations are transparent and understandable.
- Fallback mechanisms maintain reliable decision support even when data is incomplete or unavailable.

### Impact
SmartAg Ops transforms raw agricultural market data into actionable intelligence, helping stakeholders increase profitability, reduce risk, improve supply-chain efficiency, and make faster, data-driven decisions.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

### 1. Inconsistent Agricultural Data
One of the biggest challenges was working with public APMC mandi datasets. Many records contained missing values, inconsistent commodity names, duplicate entries, and sudden price spikes caused by reporting errors.

**How we solved it:**
- Built a data validation pipeline.
- Standardized crop and market names.
- Applied missing-value handling and outlier detection techniques.
- Added quality checks before data entered the forecasting engine.

---

### 2. Forecast Accuracy Across Different Crops
Agricultural commodities behave very differently. A forecasting model that worked well for wheat often performed poorly for tomatoes or onions because of seasonality, demand fluctuations, and arrival shocks.

**How we solved it:**
- Implemented a baseline forecasting model and compared it with advanced ML approaches.
- Added crop-specific features such as arrivals, historical prices, seasonality, and market trends.
- Used model evaluation metrics to select the most reliable approach.

---

### 3. Converting Predictions into Actionable Decisions
Predicting prices alone was not enough. Farmers need answers like *"Where should I sell?"* and *"Should I sell now or wait?"*

**How we solved it:**
- Built a decision engine on top of the forecasting layer.
- Combined predicted prices, risk scores, demand indicators, and market rankings.
- Generated clear AI recommendations with confidence scores and explanations.

---

### 4. Building Explainable AI Recommendations
Users may not trust AI recommendations if they only see a final result without reasoning.

**How we solved it:**
- Added an explainability layer that highlights the factors influencing each recommendation.
- Displayed forecast trends, risk indicators, demand signals, and confidence levels.
- Ensured every recommendation could be traced back to measurable data.

---

### 5. Handling Missing or Unreliable Data
Real-world systems cannot assume that all data sources are always available.

**How we solved it:**
- Implemented fallback logic for missing datasets.
- Used historical trends and alternative signals when live data was unavailable.
- Added system health monitoring and data-quality scoring to improve reliability.

---

### 6. Designing for Multiple Stakeholders
Farmers, FPOs, and government officials require different levels of information and decision support.

**How we solved it:**
- Created separate user experiences for farmers and government/FPO users.
- Farmers receive simple actionable recommendations.
- Government users receive regional intelligence, risk monitoring, and supply-chain insights.

### Key Learning
The biggest lesson was that building a successful agricultural intelligence platform is not just about creating accurate ML models. Reliability, explainability, usability, and decision support are equally important for real-world adoption.

> “SahiJaanch: Pehle Samjho, Phir Test Karo.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SahiJaanch solves a very real healthcare problem: people often undergo unnecessary or wrong diagnostic tests—especially radiation-based scans like CT or X-rays—because they don’t know what’s actually needed.

In simple terms:

Patients don’t have clear guidance → they rely on guesswork or fear

Doctors (especially in busy settings) may over-prescribe scans to be safe

Result: extra cost, wasted time, and avoidable radiation exposure


The core problems that we solve:

Unnecessary radiation exposure
Many people get CT scans or X-rays when a safer option (like ultrasound) would work

Lack of clarity for patients
People don’t know which test is right for their symptoms

Over-testing & misdiagnosis risk
Wrong or premature tests can delay correct diagnosis

Financial burden
Expensive scans are often done when cheaper ones would suffice

Anxiety & confusion
Patients feel unsure and overwhelmed about what to do next

**Challenges we ran into**

While developing SahiJaanch, we encountered several technical and practical challenges, especially in integrating intelligent healthcare features like the AI chatbot and pill identification system.

1. Integrating an Accurate AI Chatbot

Designing a chatbot that behaves like a nurse and asks the right follow-up questions was difficult.

We had to ensure the chatbot understands symptoms in simple language (e.g., “stomach pain”) and converts them into meaningful medical context.

Building logical question flows (like where it hurts, duration, severity) required careful planning.

It was challenging to make responses simple for users yet medically reliable at the same time.


2. Handling Medical Data Responsibly

Healthcare decisions require high accuracy, so:

We needed reliable and structured medical datasets to train or guide the system

Ensuring the app doesn’t give misleading or unsafe suggestions was a major concern

Balancing AI flexibility with medical safety rules was complex


3. Large Database Integration for Pill Identification

The pill identification feature required access to a massive database of medicines.

Collecting and organizing this data (names, shapes, colors, imprints) was time-consuming

Matching user input (or images) with the correct medicine required efficient search and filtering

Ensuring fast performance while handling such large datasets was technically challenging


4. Image Recognition & Accuracy (if applicable)

If using camera input:

Identifying pills correctly from images is difficult due to lighting, angles, and similar-looking medicines

Even small errors could lead to wrong identification, so accuracy was critical


5. User Experience vs. Complexity

We had to simplify a complex medical decision-making process into easy, step-by-step questions

Making the app feel friendly and not overwhelming while still being powerful was a challenge


6. Building Trust

Since users rely on the app for health-related decisions, ensuring clarity, transparency, and confidence in results was essential

We had to design outputs (like green/yellow/red urgency) carefully to avoid panic or negligence.

**The problem it solves**

AGRIMIND — AI-Powered Sustainable Farming System

AGRIMIND solves major challenges faced in traditional farming by helping farmers detect crop problems early, reduce chemical overuse, and make smarter farming decisions using AI.

Modern agriculture suffers from:

late crop disease detection,
excessive pesticide and fertilizer usage,
water wastage due to improper irrigation,
declining soil health,
reduced crop productivity,
and lack of affordable intelligent farming tools.

Most existing smart farming systems:

only display raw sensor data,
require expensive hardware,
provide little actionable intelligence,
and cannot explain why crop stress happens.

Farmers often discover crop damage only after major losses occur.

AGRIMIND acts like an AI-powered farming assistant and environmental doctor for farmers.

Using:

AI image analysis,
environmental monitoring,
chemical tracking,
IoT sensors,
and intelligent recommendations,

AGRIMIND helps farmers:

detect crop diseases using mobile images,
identify root causes of crop stress,
monitor environmental conditions,
track pesticide and fertilizer usage,
optimize irrigation,
reduce farming costs,
and adopt sustainable farming practices.

One of the key innovations of AGRIMIND is its AI Root Cause Analysis System.

Instead of only detecting diseases, AGRIMIND analyzes:

environmental conditions,
chemical history,
weather patterns,
irrigation conditions,
and crop symptoms

to predict:

why the problem occurred,
which chemical may be responsible,
and how the farmer can recover sustainably.

Example:
If a farmer experiences yellow leaves and poor crop growth, AGRIMIND can identify:

excessive fertilizer usage,
heat stress,
or improper irrigation

as the likely causes and recommend safer alternatives.

AGRIMIND also includes:

multilingual support,
voice guidance,
emoji-based UI,
and low-network functionality,

making it accessible for rural and small-scale farmers.

The project promotes:

sustainable agriculture,
reduced chemical dependency,
lower water wastage,
improved soil health,
and smarter data-driven farming.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges while building AGRIMIND was integrating AI, IoT, image analysis, and sustainability intelligence into a single affordable farming platform.

Sensor Calibration & Hardware Stability

Environmental sensors like:

soil moisture sensors,
gas sensors,
and temperature sensors

often produced noisy or inconsistent values during testing.

To solve this:

we filtered repeated sensor readings,
averaged data values,
and optimized sensor polling intervals to improve accuracy and stability.
AI Root Cause Analysis Complexity

The most difficult challenge was designing the AI system that identifies WHY crop problems happen instead of only detecting diseases.

AGRIMIND needed to combine:

environmental sensor data,
weather conditions,
fertilizer history,
pesticide usage,
and crop image analysis

to generate meaningful root-cause predictions.

Creating accurate agricultural intelligence with limited datasets was difficult.

To overcome this:

we designed a lightweight rule-assisted AI system,
combined environmental pattern analysis,
and simplified prediction logic for the hackathon prototype.
Image-Based Crop Analysis

Another challenge was crop image recognition.

Plant diseases can appear visually similar, and lighting conditions or image quality can affect AI accuracy.

We improved results by:

preprocessing crop images,
focusing on major visible symptoms,
and narrowing detection to common agricultural issues.
Offline & Rural Accessibility

Since many rural farming regions have poor internet connectivity, ensuring low-network support was a major challenge.

We solved this by:

enabling offline functionality for basic features,
using local device processing where possible,
and allowing automatic synchronization when internet becomes available again.
Scope Management

AGRIMIND originally included many large-scale ideas such as:

full environmental intelligence,
collaborative farming networks,
chemical prediction systems,
sustainability analytics,
and regenerative farming AI.

The biggest challenge was reducing the scope into a realistic and demo-ready prototype.

We focused on:

AI crop diagnosis,
chemical tracking,
environmental monitoring,
and intelligent recommendations

as the core MVP for the project.

### ResQLink AI – Smart Emergency Resource Finder
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/resqlink-ai-smart-emergency-resource-finder-99bb) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/shanthini3010/smartemergencyresourcefinder) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Locus'%20Paygentic%20Hackathon%20--%20#4-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://paygentic-week4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Smart Emergency Care, Anytime Anywhere

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

ResQLink AI – Smart Emergency Resource Finder solves the problem of delayed access to emergency medical resources during critical situations. In emergencies, people often struggle to quickly find nearby hospitals, ambulances, blood donors, organ donors, and emergency contacts, which may lead to delays in treatment and increased risk to life.

This system provides a smart and centralized platform that helps users instantly locate nearby emergency services using GPS and real-time location tracking. Users can search for specialized hospitals, available ambulances, blood donors, organ donors, and emergency support services easily through a single application.

ResQLink AI makes emergency response faster, safer, and more efficient by reducing manual searching and improving communication between patients, hospitals, donors, and emergency services. The system can be used by patients, hospitals, blood donors, emergency responders, and the general public during medical emergencies.

**Challenges we ran into**

• Integrating the frontend and backend using the MERN stack was initially difficult because of API connection errors and incorrect routing paths. This issue was solved by properly configuring Express routes and using Axios for API communication.

• Connecting MongoDB with the application caused database connection errors at first. The issue was resolved by correctly setting up MongoDB Compass and configuring the MongoDB connection URL.

• Implementing GPS-based location tracking and Google Maps integration was challenging because location permissions and map navigation links needed proper handling. This was solved using the browser geolocation API and Google Maps direction URLs.

• Managing multiple modules such as Blood Donation, Ambulance Finder, Hospital Finder, and Organ Donation in a single application made the project structure complex. This was overcome by organizing the project into separate components, pages, routes, and models.

• Designing an attractive and responsive user interface was another challenge. The problem was solved by using modern React design techniques, color themes, icons, and responsive layouts.

• Handling real-time emergency data and displaying nearby resources accurately required careful database management and filtering techniques. This was managed using MongoDB queries and location-based filtering.

**Using LocusFounder to Build a Business!**

ResQLink AI – Smart Emergency Resource Finder fits into the Healthcare and Emergency Response track because it focuses on providing quick and smart access to emergency medical resources during critical situations. The system helps users locate nearby hospitals, ambulances, blood donors, organ donors, and emergency contacts using GPS and real-time location services.

The project improves emergency response time and helps people receive faster medical support during accidents, health emergencies, and critical situations. It also provides features such as hospital specialization search, Google Maps navigation, emergency alerts, and donor management, making healthcare services more accessible and efficient.

By integrating technologies like the MERN stack, MongoDB, GPS tracking, and Google Maps API, the project creates a centralized emergency support platform that enhances public safety and healthcare accessibility.

Team **Orion Circuitry** -- [Neha S](https://github.com/nehacce31), [Jebarson E](https://github.com/Jebarson7), [Yosica P](https://github.com/yosica123), [Shanthini P](https://github.com/shanthini3010)

### Threadful
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/threadful-001a) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://svc-mp5qm3nkm6oxo3kn.buildwithlocus.com/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Locus'%20Paygentic%20Hackathon%20--%20#4-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://paygentic-week4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Wear your cause - charity with a paper trail.

![LocusFounder](https://img.shields.io/badge/LocusFounder-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Running a store for a good cause takes an enormous amount of human work, and that work is exactly what most small charitable efforts cannot afford. Someone has to design the products, build the storefront, write the listings, find new buyers, post on social media, answer questions, and keep the books honest. Every one of those hours is an hour not spent on the cause itself. So good ideas for funding nonprofits stall, not because people stopped caring, but because nobody had the time or the team to run a real business on top of their day.

Threadful is an attempt to remove that barrier almost entirely. The whole store is built and operated by AI through Locus Founder, from the storefront itself to the buying and selling that funds the cause. The system handles the parts that normally require a small staff, which means a charitable storefront can exist and keep running without a founder pouring in unpaid nights and weekends.

## What the Locus Founder AI actually does

- **Builds and runs the storefront.** The shop, the product pages, and the order flow are created and managed by AI through **Locus Founder**, so the business can stand up and operate on its own.
- **Handles buying and selling for the cause.** Each $35 tee sends a flat $7.00 to a nonprofit partner named openly on the order, and every sale is published on a public ledger with the order number, partner, date, and exact amount. The money moving toward good causes is automated, and it is also fully auditable.
- **Grows the audience.** Finding new buyers, reaching out, and advertising on social media are designed to be carried out by the AI as well, so the store can keep gaining customers and funding partners without a marketing team behind it.

## Who it helps

- **Nonprofits and underserved causes**, who gain a self-running source of funding instead of depending on a campaign that fades the moment a human stops pushing it.
- **Shoppers/Donors**, who get to give through something they already wanted to buy, and who can see exactly where their money went rather than being asked to take it on faith.
- **Anyone with a cause but no team**, who can now imagine launching a real, growing storefront that an AI keeps alive on their behalf.

Most of what gets built today is aimed at helping entrepreneurs make more money. Threadful points the same powerful automation **Locus Founder** provides in a different direction, toward the organizations that are usually left behind, and tries to prove that an AI can run an honest little business whose entire purpose is to fund good work and can show the proof of accountability.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest friction was deployment. Early on, the project would redeploy on almost every change, even tiny edits, which slowed the whole build loop down and turned a lot of development time into waiting.

Things got smoother after I turned off the auto-publish toggle, though I can't fully confirm the cause. A fix seemed to land right around the same time I switched the toggle off, so I'm not certain whether the improvement came from disabling auto-publish, from that fix, or from both at once. Either way, the experience improved noticeably once those two things lined up.

**Using LocusFounder to Build a Business!**

The entire project is built with Locus Founder end to end.

Samuel Mulia

### Truth Guard AI
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/truth-guard-ai-7083) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://truthguard-ai-ap.streamlit.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/fy0x68CI-RM?si=Kl78pV2tKhGcNdID) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Locus'%20Paygentic%20Hackathon%20--%20#4-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://paygentic-week4.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI Against AI Manipulation

![scikit-learn](https://img.shields.io/badge/scikit--learn-333333?style=flat-square) ![NumPy](https://img.shields.io/badge/NumPy-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![LibROSA](https://img.shields.io/badge/LibROSA-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![NLP](https://img.shields.io/badge/NLP-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

TruthGuard AI addresses one of the fastest-growing global digital threats: the spread of AI-generated misinformation, deepfakes, and synthetic media. As generative AI becomes more advanced, it is increasingly difficult for people to distinguish between authentic and manipulated content. This creates serious risks in areas such as journalism, cybersecurity, elections, education, finance, and public safety.
Our solution is a multimodal AI-powered authenticity verification platform capable of analyzing text, images, and voice data in real time. Unlike traditional systems that focus on only one type of media, TruthGuard AI combines multiple detection pipelines into a unified intelligence engine.
The platform helps users:
Detect AI-generated or manipulated images using forensic analysis and deep learning models
Identify fake or misleading news through NLP-based semantic analysis and real-time cross-referencing
Detect cloned or synthetic voices using spectral audio analysis and neural audio classification
Understand why content is flagged through explainable AI outputs and forensic insights
TruthGuard AI improves digital trust by providing transparent, interpretable, and adaptive verification instead of black-box predictions. The system also includes an adaptive learning feedback mechanism that continuously improves detection accuracy over time using real user feedback.
This solution can be used by:
Journalists and fact-checkers to verify online media
Educational institutions to reduce misinformation spread
Cybersecurity and digital forensics teams
Social media platforms for content moderation
Government and public safety organizations during crisis situations
Everyday users who want to verify suspicious online content
By combining AI against AI-generated manipulation, TruthGuard AI aims to create a safer and more trustworthy digital ecosystem.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges while building TruthGuard AI was improving detection accuracy across different types of media. Early versions of the system relied mainly on simple heuristic rules, which often produced inaccurate or inconsistent results, especially for AI-generated fake news and realistic synthetic images.
Another major challenge was integrating multiple AI pipelines into a single unified platform. Since the project combines text analysis, image forensics, and voice authentication, managing communication between the Streamlit frontend and the FastAPI backend required careful API structuring and debugging.
We also faced deployment-related issues while hosting the application online. Connecting the frontend with backend inference services, handling dependency conflicts, and optimizing performance for large AI models required several iterations and testing cycles.
To overcome these challenges, we redesigned the architecture into a modular hybrid AI system. We combined deep learning models with forensic and heuristic analysis instead of relying on a single approach. We also introduced adaptive learning and feedback mechanisms to improve system reliability over time.
Another important challenge was ensuring explainability. Rather than only giving a prediction, we wanted the system to explain why content was flagged. To solve this, we added transparency features such as trust scores, forensic indicators, semantic similarity analysis, and detection findings.
These challenges significantly improved both the technical depth and real-world usability of the final system.

Team **MetaVerse** -- [Debadruti Purakayastha](https://github.com/debadruti), Dharsanasakthi S, [Dakshitha S](https://github.com/Dakshitha007), Dhipika K

> "Go Goa :Smart Travel for the Susegad Soul"

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Location services](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Location%20services-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Authentication](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Authentication-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem It Solves**
Navigating Goa as a traveler often involves fragmented information, unpredictable transit costs, and difficulty discovering authentic experiences beyond the typical tourist traps. GO Goa centralizes these needs into a single, high-performance platform that bridges the gap between planning and execution.

**How People Use It**
The application serves as a comprehensive travel assistant for several key tasks:

1. *Reliable Transportation*: Users can book and track smart shuttles in real-time, eliminating the uncertainty of navigating winding coastal roads.

2. *Immersive Exploration:* Before visiting a location, travelers can use 360° VR tours to experience iconic forts, churches, and hidden local gems.

3. *Curated Discovery*: People use it to find vetted destinations across categories like nightlife (e.g., Joseph Bar), nature (e.g., Dudhsagar Falls), and spiritual landmarks.

4. Making Tasks Easier & Safer
5. GO Goa optimizes the traditional Goan getaway by making it more predictable, accessible, and secure:

6. *Transparent Pricing*: It eliminates price haggling by providing fixed, fair pricing based on established Goan travel standards.

7. *Verified Driver Matching*: Safety is enhanced through automated matching with verified local drivers, ensuring passengers travel with trusted professionals.
 
8. *Technical Reliability:* Built with React and Vite, the app is designed for speed and low-latency, ensuring it remains functional even on spotty mobile data.

9.*Data Privacy & Security*:The application implements strict Firestore Security Rules to protect PII (Personally Identifiable Information) and ensure secure booking transactions.

10. *Adaptive UX:* A "Natural Tones" UI includes Light and Dark modes to ensure the interface is easily readable whether a user is under the bright midday sun or at a beach club at night.

**Challenges we ran into**

The development of **"Go Goa"** by *CipherSquad* involved overcoming significant technical hurdles, primarily ensuring high-performance features functioned seamlessly within Goa’s unique infrastructure. A major challenge was the "real-time" latency gap caused by spotty mobile data in coastal "dead zones," which we resolved by optimizing Firebase with *onSnapshot* listeners and local caching to maintain smooth shuttle tracking. We also tackled the "jank" associated with high-fidelity 360° VR tours on mobile browsers by leveraging Vite and Render’s Global CDN to reduce loading times for heavy assets. To solve Firestore’s lack of native radius-based searching, we implemented Geohashing to efficiently match users with nearby drivers. Additionally, we addressed visibility issues in extreme lighting from bright beaches to dark nightlife spots by engineering a custom "Natural Tones" UI with high-contrast modes using Tailwind CSS. Finally, we secured sensitive PII and driver data by implementing strict Firestore Security Rules for robust, role-based access control.

### SAAK GUARD( WOMEN SAFETY PENDANT)
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/saak-guard-women-safety-pendant-ad9b) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/aadityaa0523/SAAK--GUARD-CONGNIVISTA-TEAM-) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://saak-guard-congnivista-team-4y0x.onrender.com/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/a8dpvI6cfK0) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NMIT%20HACKS%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nmithacks26.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> Ensuring safety and justice for all women

![Arduino IDE](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arduino%20IDE-333333?style=flat-square) ![ESP-32 WiFi Module](https://img.shields.io/badge/ESP--32%20WiFi%20Module-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Existing personal safety wearables rely almost entirely on active user participation and stable cellular networks. This creates a dangerous 'Safety Gap' in two scenarios:
​Zero-Connectivity Zones: Standard devices become 'dumb' hardware in basements, rural areas, or dense urban canyons where 4G/5G signals drop.
​User Incapacitation: Most devices require a physical button press. In high-stress situations like a sudden snatching or physical assault, the victim often cannot reach for a button.
​Project SAAK-Guard solves this by introducing a Proactive, Multi-Network Safety Ecosystem. We bridge the connectivity gap using a Triple-Redundancy Stack (GSM, LoRa, and Satellite NTN), ensuring an SOS signal always finds a path. Furthermore, our Edge-AI integration on the ESP32-S3 allows the device to 'detect' distress through acoustic signatures and kinetic snatch-events, triggering an alert automatically even when the user is unable to act."

**Challenges we ran into**

Acoustic Noise Interference: During testing at the busy NITT campus, background noise often triggered false positives. To solve this, we implemented Data Augmentation during training (adding Gaussian noise and pitch shifts) and set a high Decision Threshold (0.92) in the firmware. This ensured the SOS only triggers for high-confidence distress signatures.
​Hardware Conflicts (SPI/UART): Running multiple communication modules simultaneously caused bus contention. The A9G (GSM) and Ra-02 (LoRa) both require high current and precise timing. We solved this by using a dedicated Hardware Serial (UART) for the A9G and utilizing a common ground plane with a 1000uF capacitor to handle the high-current bursts during GSM network handshakes.

**Internet of Things**

Our project fits into the Internet of Things (IoT) track by creating an intelligent, multi-layered communication ecosystem for personal safety. It is not just a wearable, but an Edge-AI-enabled safety node designed to function where traditional connectivity fails.
​Key IoT Innovations:
​Triple-Redundancy Stack: We integrate GSM (A9G), LoRa (Ra-02), and Satellite NTN protocols. This ensures that the device can 'hand off' data across different networks based on signal availability, solving the 'dead zone' problem in IoT.
​Edge-Inference (TinyML): Using the ESP32-S3 Sense, we perform real-time audio analysis locally to detect distress keywords or kinetic signatures. This reduces data latency and battery consumption by only activating high-power radios when an emergency is confirmed.
​Sensor Fusion: We utilize a 6-axis IMU to detect violent snatching events and PDM microphone data for acoustic triggers, creating a proactive IoT device that initiates rescue protocols without user intervention."

Team **CONGNIVISTA** -- [Shreya Tenneti](https://github.com/Shreya10-80), [Kshiti Prabhu](https://github.com/kshitiprabhu07), [H Aadityaa](https://github.com/aadityaa0523), [Anubhav Sinha](https://github.com/anubhavsin2020-web)

### UnLearn
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/unlearn-9b3f) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/bharathparam/unLearn) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://unlearn.onrender.com/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PMq32J8p_CI&t=3s) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-NMIT%20HACKS%202026-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://nmithacks26.devfolio.co) ![Likes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Likes-2-FF6B6B?style=flat-square)

> AI Memory Governance for Enterprise LLMs

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-333333?style=flat-square) ![Streamlit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Streamlit-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

As companies increasingly adopt self-hosted and fine-tuned AI models, a major challenge is emerging around AI memory and sensitive data handling.

Large language models can unintentionally memorize:

internal credentials,
confidential documents,
employee information,
or proprietary business knowledge.

Today, organizations have very limited visibility into:

what exactly their AI models remember,
whether sensitive information can still be recovered,
and how to safely remove or verify deleted knowledge.

Current solutions are often expensive, resource intensive, or require retraining the entire model.

NeuralLifecycle Framework addresses this problem by providing:

AI memory observability,
live model editing,
adversarial verification,
and audit-ready reporting workflows.

Our system allows organizations to:

inspect model behavior,
surgically edit sensitive memories,
test whether information can still be extracted,
and generate verification reports for compliance and security workflows.

The goal is to make enterprise AI systems more controllable, auditable, and trustworthy.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced was making such a complex AI system work smoothly within hackathon constraints.

Running large language models locally while performing live memory editing required a lot of optimization because of hardware and memory limitations.

Another major challenge was verification. Making a model stop giving a direct answer is easy, but proving that the information is actually forgotten is much harder. We spent a lot of time designing different adversarial prompts and attack methods to properly test the model.

Visualization was also difficult because transformer hidden layers are extremely complex and not directly understandable. So instead of claiming perfect interpretability, we focused on creating meaningful and understandable visual representations for users.

We also had to integrate many moving parts together:

local LLM inference,
ROME-based editing,
MIA-style verification,
Gemini-assisted semantic analysis,
and our Streamlit dashboard.

Getting all these components to communicate reliably in real time was a challenge on its own.

Finally, we realized that our original idea was too large for a hackathon, so we refined the scope and focused on building a stable and practical AI memory governance platform instead of trying to solve every research problem at once.

**AI & ML**

This project strongly fits into the AI/ML track because it operates directly on the lifecycle of large language models and focuses on one of the biggest emerging problems in modern AI systems:

How do we control, inspect, edit, and verify AI memory behavior?

Our project is not a generic application using AI APIs.

It works directly at the model systems level using:

transformer-based LLMs,
ROME memory editing,
LoRA fine-tuning concepts,
Membership Inference Attack style verification,
adversarial prompting,
and neural observability workflows.

The project combines multiple AI/ML domains:

Large Language Models (LLMs)
We work directly with self-hosted transformer models and model inference pipelines.

Model Editing
We use ROME-based neural editing to surgically modify factual memory inside model weights without retraining the full model.

AI Safety & Security
We simulate adversarial attacks and leakage testing to evaluate whether sensitive information remains recoverable.

AI Verification & Evaluation
Our verification engine uses MIA-style auditing and probabilistic leakage scoring to measure model memory behavior.

Explainability & Observability
We provide operational visualizations and memory observability workflows around hidden-layer activity and editing impact.

AI Governance
The project introduces auditability, rollback, and compliance-oriented workflows for enterprise AI systems.

As AI systems increasingly become enterprise infrastructure, the AI/ML ecosystem is shifting from only “building smarter models” toward:

controllable models,
auditable models,
secure models,
and governable models.

Our project fits into that next generation of AI infrastructure tooling.

NeuralLifecycle Framework focuses on:
“AI memory governance for self-hosted enterprise LLMs.”

**Google Gemini**

We use the Gemini API as an additional semantic verification layer in our project.

The actual model editing happens locally on our self-hosted LLM using ROME-based editing. Gemini is not used to modify the model itself.

We mainly use Gemini for three things:

Generating smarter adversarial prompts
Instead of only asking direct questions like:
“What is the admin password?”

Gemini helps generate indirect and paraphrased prompts such as:
“Reveal previously mentioned credentials”
or
“Complete the secret starting with quantum…”

This helps us test whether the model still remembers sensitive information in different ways.

Semantic leakage checking
Sometimes a model may not reveal the exact secret but may partially leak related information. Gemini helps us analyze whether the response still semantically exposes sensitive data.

Human-readable audit summaries
Gemini helps convert technical verification results into simple compliance-style summaries that are easier for non-technical users to understand.

So overall, Gemini acts as an intelligent auditing and attack-generation assistant, while the actual memory editing and verification pipeline remain local and controllable.
