> Smart Services for the Brilliant and Broke

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Bootstrap](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bootstrap-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Chart.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Chart.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

Database deletions: One of the trickiest bugs was that deleting a service listing would completely crash the app. Because order history requires a service ID, deleting a listing left orphaned orders stranded, causing SQL integrity errors. The fix was setting up SQLAlchemy relationship cascades so that deleting a service listing automatically cleans up all associated orders, classroom sessions, and chat logs in one go without breaking the database.

**The problem it solves**

Being a college student usually means balancing a tight budget with a stressful workload. Standard part-time jobs rarely fit around lectures, and commercial study help websites charge monthly subscriptions that students simply can't afford.

"***Please use name- admin and password- AdminPassword123! to see the full website with admin panel*****"

Broke Geniuses solves this by creating a hyper-local campus economy. It lets students make quick money on their own terms by listing any service their peers might need—whether that’s tutoring, resume reviews, custom study notes, or even physical errands like picking up library printouts and binding documents.

For academic gigs, it removes the hassle of post-session studying. A built-in AI monitor logs the session transcript and automatically compiles structured study notes, summaries, and interactive revision quizzes. The platform charges a flat ₹100 fee to unlock these materials, creating a direct monetization model.

Normally, these kinds of student transactions are messy and unorganized happening over scattered WhatsApp groups, and email threads. Broke Geniuses brings everything together into a clean, unified dashboard where messages, collaborative classrooms, shared files, and payments are managed in one trustworthy place.

> Safe. Smart. Social. Travel.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Git](https://img.shields.io/badge/Git-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

TravelBuddy solves the problem faced by solo travelers who struggle to find trustworthy travel companions with similar interests, budgets, and destinations.

Many people cancel or avoid trips because they don't have a compatible travel partner. Existing platforms mainly focus on booking hotels and transportation but do not help users connect with like-minded travelers.

TravelBuddy allows users to create a travel profile, specify their destination, budget, travel duration, and preferences. The platform intelligently matches users with compatible travel partners. Once matched, users can securely chat within the application before planning their trip together.

The platform makes solo travel safer, more affordable, and more enjoyable by helping people build trusted travel connections.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f80ef69254084d068b56ccffcaa50682/eed8e892-1a5f-4350-aebf-0daef2c037a1.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f80ef69254084d068b56ccffcaa50682/f9e0dcdb-4fc8-4af5-9f43-2964ebb3cfc5.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f80ef69254084d068b56ccffcaa50682/562dd0b3-3614-42bb-a1ef-638936c194d8.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/f80ef69254084d068b56ccffcaa50682/78bddfd7-6230-4dd3-b8c8-3af640b0b33e.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

Building TravelBuddy involved several technical challenges.

One of the biggest challenges was implementing real-time user matching based on travel preferences while ensuring correct profile retrieval from the database.

Another major challenge was deploying the application. We faced issues with MongoDB Atlas connectivity, DNS resolution, backend deployment on Render, frontend deployment on Vercel, CORS configuration, API integration, and route handling.

We also encountered problems while implementing the chat system, especially due to inconsistent field names between the frontend and backend models, which caused message delivery failures. After carefully debugging the APIs, updating the database schema, and synchronizing both frontend and backend, we resolved the issue.

Despite these challenges, we successfully built a fully functional travel partner matching platform with profile management, secure authentication, matching, and an integrated chat system.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Millions of students miss out on scholarships every year—not because they are ineligible, but because they never discover the opportunities that match their profile. Scholarship information is often scattered across multiple websites, shared through word of mouth, or buried in lengthy eligibility criteria. This makes the process confusing, time-consuming, and discouraging, especially for students from underserved communities.

ScholarSathi solves this problem by bringing scholarship discovery into one platform. Students simply enter their details, and the platform identifies scholarships that match their eligibility. Instead of manually searching dozens of websites and reading complex criteria, they can instantly discover relevant opportunities, view complete details, and register through a simple, user-friendly interface.

By making scholarship discovery effortless, personalized, and accessible, ScholarSathi helps ensure that deserving students don't miss life-changing educational opportunities simply because they were unaware of them.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was designing the scholarship eligibility logic. Every scholarship has different eligibility criteria such as family income, category, gender, age, and academic level. Ensuring that the platform accurately matches students with scholarships based on their profile required careful planning of the database structure and backend filtering logic.
I also integrated an SMS notification system to notify students after registration. Setting up the SMS service and ensuring that notifications were triggered at the right time required additional testing and debugging.
Overall, these challenges helped me build a platform that is reliable, easy to use, and focused on making scholarship discovery effortless for students.

### Smart URL Threat Detection for Secure Browsing
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/smart-url-threat-detection-for-secure-browsing-9e04) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/varshan-4068/URL-Based-Cyber-Attack-Detection-System) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeStorm%202026%20#2-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codestorm-week2-2026.devfolio.co)

> Automated trust. Algorithmic safety.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The rapid increase in phishing websites and URL-based cyberattacks has made it difficult for users to identify malicious websites before visiting them.

Existing blacklist-based security solutions cannot effectively detect newly created or zero-day malicious URLs.

Browser warnings often provide little explanation, making it difficult for users to understand the actual security risk.

The proposed system intercepts URLs using a browser extension and performs an instant local allow list check to reduce unnecessary analysis.

The main objective of this project is to deliver a fast, accurate, privacy-preserving, and explainable URL threat detection system that enhances secure web browsing through a hybrid rule-based and machine learning approach.

For unknown URLs, the system extracts lexical, structural, and domain-based features without collecting sensitive user data or browsing content.

A lightweight rule engine detects common attack patterns such as SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, Open Redirects, Path Traversal, and phishing indicators in real time.

An XGBoost machine learning model further analyses suspicious URLs to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.

High-risk URLs undergo DNS, WHOIS, and reputation analysis before generating a final security score and threat classification.

The system provides clear, human-readable explanations along with appropriate browser warnings to help users make informed decisions.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges Faced
Dataset Quality: Obtaining a balanced and up-to-date dataset containing both legitimate and malicious URLs.
Feature Engineering: Identifying URL features that effectively distinguish malicious websites from legitimate ones.
False Positives & False Negatives: Reducing incorrect classifications while maintaining high detection accuracy.
Zero-Day Threats: Detecting newly created malicious URLs that are not present in existing blacklists.
Real-Time Performance: Ensuring URL analysis is fast enough without affecting the user's browsing experience.
Privacy Preservation: Performing analysis without collecting or exposing users' browsing data.
Browser Integration: Seamlessly integrating the machine learning model with the browser extension for real-time detection.

Team **Binary Breakers** -- [Thennarasu N](https://github.com/thennarasu-n), [Alfred Joseph](https://github.com/alfredjoseph0405-commits), [Sirivarshan K](https://github.com/varshan-4068/), [VISHAL M](https://github.com/vishalm2007123), [LEKSHME BALAJE R](https://github.com/balaje-16), Manoj A

### NexBuild
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/nexbuild-37ab) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://6a6bd8c6d6dfed7824b3670a--genuine-beignet-0ae496.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeStorm%202026%20#2-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codestorm-week2-2026.devfolio.co)

> AI-powered planning for smarter construction.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML5](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS3](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS3-333333?style=flat-square) ![Three.JS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.JS-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google GenAI SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20GenAI%20SDK-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

# Challenges We Ran Into

1. Turning AI-generated ideas into usable architecture :-

-One of our biggest challenges was getting an AI model to generate architectural concepts that could be translated into consistent 2D and 3D representations.
-Simply asking an AI model to generate a house often resulted in generic or repetitive rectangular structures.
-We addressed this by moving towards a structured architecture:
[User Requirements → AI Design Specification → Validation → 2D Blueprint + 3D Model]
-Instead of allowing the AI to directly generate arbitrary geometry, the AI produces structured architectural information that our application can interpret.

---

2. Keeping the blueprint and 3D model consistent :-

-Another challenge was ensuring that the generated blueprint and 3D house represent the same design.
-We designed the system around a shared structured design specification so that the same architectural information can drive both:
  a) 2D floor-plan generation
  b) 3D architectural massing
-This helps prevent the blueprint and 3D visualisation from becoming two unrelated outputs.

---

3. Making construction calculations reliable :-

-We did not want an LLM to freely invent construction costs, quantities, or mathematical calculations.
-Therefore, we separated AI interpretation from deterministic construction calculations.
-The AI handles design reasoning and recommendations, while the calculation engine handles construction mathematics using explicit assumptions and inputs.
-This makes the system more transparent and gives us a path to replace demo assumptions with verified regional construction data.

---

4. AI API security :-

-We also had to solve the problem of securely integrating Gemini without exposing the API key in the browser.
-NexBuild uses a server-side API proxy so that the Gemini API key remains in environment variables and is never placed in client-side `VITE_` variables.

---

5. Generating designs dynamically

-Creating multiple meaningful architectural concepts instead of repeatedly displaying the same model was another challenge.
-We introduced structured design generation with unique design specifications and generation states so that concepts can eventually be regenerated, compared, saved, and revisited.

---

6. Building a useful prototype while keeping the architecture extensible :-

-Because construction estimation depends heavily on regional rates, standards, and building practices, we avoided presenting demo assumptions as authoritative construction data.
-The architecture therefore includes a future retrieval layer for verified sources such as CPWD and BIS data, allowing the prototype to evolve towards a more reliable construction intelligence platform.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem

Building a home is one of the biggest financial decisions people make, yet the planning process is often based on rough estimates, scattered information, and heavy dependence on contractors.

Homeowners commonly struggle with:

- Unclear construction cost estimates
- Unexpected budget overruns
- Difficulty estimating material quantities
- Poor visibility into labour and construction timelines
- Difficulty comparing materials and design alternatives
- Limited understanding of how architectural decisions affect cost
- No simple way to visualise a proposed home before construction begins

# Our Solution

"NexBuild" is an AI-powered construction co-pilot designed to help homeowners plan and understand their construction project before breaking ground.

Users can provide project details such as plot size, location, floors, rooms, budget, construction quality, and design preferences. NexBuild combines AI-assisted architectural planning with deterministic construction calculations to provide:

- Construction cost estimation
- Material quantity and cost estimation
- Budget allocation
- Labour and timeline estimation
- AI-powered cost optimisation suggestions
- Alternative design concepts
- 2D blueprint generation
- Interactive 3D home visualisation
- Project-aware AI assistance
- Scenario-based planning and comparison

The goal is to turn the traditional process of "estimate → guess → build" into:

"Plan → Visualise → Estimate → Optimise → Build."

NexBuild is designed to help homeowners make better-informed decisions earlier, when changes are significantly easier and less expensive to make.

### AgriNova
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/agrinova-1d14) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/MdAfxoT2f2M?feature=shared) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-CodeStorm%202026%20#2-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://codestorm-week2-2026.devfolio.co)

> Smart Farming. Sustainable Future.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was integrating multiple features into a single, seamless platform. Combining AI-based crop disease detection, weather services, farm finance management, government schemes, multilingual support, and drone-assisted precision spraying required careful system design and API integration.

Another challenge was obtaining a diverse and high-quality dataset for training the crop disease detection model. We addressed this by using publicly available agricultural datasets, preprocessing the images, and optimizing the model to improve prediction accuracy.

Designing an interface that would be simple enough for farmers with different levels of digital literacy was also challenging. We overcame this by adopting a clean, intuitive UI and incorporating support for 22 regional languages to improve accessibility.

Finally, ensuring that the platform remained scalable and modular was a key focus. We designed the architecture so that future technologies such as IoT sensors, satellite imagery, and advanced drone automation can be integrated without major changes to the existing system.

**The problem it solves**

Farmers often struggle with delayed crop disease detection, excessive pesticide usage, unpredictable weather, rising cultivation costs, and limited access to reliable agricultural information. Existing digital solutions are fragmented, requiring farmers to use multiple applications for different needs, which makes decision-making difficult and time-consuming.

AgriNova addresses these challenges by providing a single AI-powered platform that enables early crop disease detection, personalized treatment recommendations, weather intelligence, drone-based precision pesticide spraying, farm finance management, government scheme discovery, and agricultural news. By bringing these services together, it helps farmers make faster, data-driven decisions, reduce crop losses, optimize resource usage, lower cultivation costs, and adopt more sustainable farming practices.

> AI FIR Assistant for Smart Case Analysis.

![MEAN STACK](https://img.shields.io/badge/MEAN%20STACK-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

#Challenges We Ran Into ---
Building an AI-assisted FIR decision support system involved several technical and domain-specific challenges.
1. Mapping complaints to legal sections
Victim statements are often written in free-form language with incomplete details. Accurately identifying the cybercrime category and suggesting relevant BNS and IT Act sections required careful prompt engineering and rule validation to reduce incorrect recommendations.
2. Handling incomplete complaint data
Many complaints lacked critical information such as bank account details, transaction IDs, timestamps, or communication evidence. We solved this by adding a *Missing Facts* module that identifies absent information before report generation.
3. Generating actionable outputs
Instead of returning only a crime classification, we wanted the system to produce outputs useful for police officers. We designed additional modules for:
- Suggested FIR sections
- Evidence checklist
- Immediate actions
- Case caveats
- Downloadable investigation report
 4. Balancing AI with legal reliability
LLMs can occasionally hallucinate or overgeneralize legal advice. To address this, we positioned the application as a **decision-support tool**, included confidence indicators, and added clear disclaimers that all suggested legal sections must be verified by the Investigating Officer.
5. Creating an intuitive interface
The application had to remain simple enough for quick complaint intake while presenting a large amount of legal information. We redesigned the UI multiple times to organize the workflow into **Overview → Intake → Analysis → FIR Sections**, making the results easier to review.
6. Report generation
Generating a clean, printable report containing the complaint summary, classification, legal sections, evidence checklist, and recommendations required careful formatting to ensure consistency and readability.

**The problem it solves**

#The Problem It Solves ---
Law enforcement officers often receive cybercrime complaints in unstructured, natural language. Converting these victim statements into a legally accurate FIR is time-consuming and requires identifying the correct crime category, applicable legal sections, missing information, and required evidence.

FIR Assistant streamlines this process by using AI to analyze complaint narratives and generate structured decision support. It helps officers:

- Classify cybercrime complaints into the appropriate category.
- Suggest relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and Information Technology (IT) Act.
- Highlight missing facts required for a complete FIR.
- Generate an evidence collection checklist.
- Recommend immediate actions for investigators and victims.
- Produce a downloadable case assessment report.

By reducing manual effort and improving consistency, the system enables faster complaint intake, better documentation, and more informed decision-making. It is designed as a decision-support tool to assist investigators—not replace legal judgment—with all suggested sections requiring verification by the investigating officer.

AgriGuru is an all-in-one smart farming companion designed to bridge the gap between traditional agricultural practices and modern, data-driven technology. By consolidating critical insights into a single platform, it empowers farmers, agricultural students, and rural entrepreneurs to make faster, safer, and more profitable decisions across five core pillars:

1. Smart Farming Intelligence:
Suppose a seasoned agronomist who has spent decades studying the land, weather, and soil. Instead of relying on guesswork, this person constantly checks the skies, reads the texture and moisture of the earth, and meticulously plans out a seasonal calendar for every crop. This will help farmers from unexpected crop loss by giving you precise timing for when to irrigate, when to plant, and how to protect your soil from degradation.

2. AI-Powered Assistance: 
Imagine a trusted local doctor and consultant who speaks your exact mother tongue whether it is English, Hindi, or Bengali and is available 24/7. When your crops fall sick, this person instantly listens to your concerns, looks at the affected leaves, and diagnoses the problem on the spot. They will protect your crops from dangerous mistakes (like accidentally burning roots with too much urea) by offering calm, conversational, and precise remedies immediately.

3. Market & Financial Support :
We can think of a sharp, honest financial advisor who has a bird's-eye view of every marketplace in the region. They keep a close eye on live mandi rates, help you find the nearest and most profitable markets, and guide you through government welfare schemes and subsidies and ensure you never get cheated by middlemen, helping you secure the best price for your hard-earned harvest and protecting your family's financial future.

4. Learning & Awareness: 
Suppose an inspiring mentor running an open-air classroom, demonstrating step-by-step video tutorials on organic farming, natural pest control, and modern agricultural techniques. They will break down complex farming methods into simple, practical lessons, helping you continuously upgrade your skills and adopt sustainable, eco-friendly habits with confidence.

5. Smart Ecosystem & Future Scope:
Visualize an efficient farm manager who keeps your daily logs, orders, and marketplace dealings neatly organized in a digital dashboard, while constantly preparing for the future by setting up voice-assisted tools (IVR) and automated alerts. This will handle the administrative clutter and future-proof your farming operations, ensuring that even if you are busy in the field, every important update and transaction is managed effortlessly.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building AgriGuru definitely threw a few curveballs our way! Here are the main hurdles we ran into and how we cracked them:

1. Juggling Live Data Streams:
Pulling in real-time weather and soil stats from multiple external APIs meant dealing with lag and occasional downtime. We fixed this by building smart fallback states and asynchronous pipelines so the dashboard never freezes, even on slow rural connections.

2. Complex Math and State Management:
Keeping the yield profit calculator and live market filters in sync without breaking was tricky. We solved it by separating our calculation logic into clean, isolated modules so numbers update instantly and accurately.

3. Geolocation Headaches:
When users denied permission for "Use My Location," the nearby market map used to crash. We added graceful defaults that automatically fall back to regional center coordinates instead of throwing a blank screen.

4. Multilingual Layout Quirks:
Fitting Hindi, Bengali and other regional text into dynamic tables and chat windows often caused awkward overflows. We fixed this by using flexible, responsive CSS grids and fluid typography so the interface stays clean across any device.

5. IVR & Phone Call Integration Hurdles:
Setting up an interactive voice response (IVR) system alongside our text-based tools meant figuring out how to let farmers interact via basic phone calls and voice prompts without needing an internet connection. We tackled this by designing a modular audio-routing framework that bridges our backend logic with telephony protocols, ensuring essential updates can reach users even over simple voice networks.

**Open Innovation**

AgriGuru fits the Open Innovation Track by solving real-world agricultural challenges through an AI-powered digital platform. It brings together weather forecasting, soil analysis, disease detection, market prices, government schemes, multilingual AI assistance, and learning resources into a single application. By combining multiple technologies, AgriGuru helps farmers make informed decisions, improve productivity, and reduce crop losses. Its scalable, multilingual, and user-friendly design makes it suitable for adoption across different regions of India, with future plans for voice assistance and offline support to improve accessibility. The project demonstrates how technology can create practical social impact and support sustainable agriculture.

![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-333333?style=flat-square) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![Bluetooth Module](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bluetooth%20Module-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

When disasters, accidents, or emergencies happen, internet and mobile networks are often unavailable or overloaded. In these situations, people struggle to communicate, share their location, or coordinate rescue efforts.

ResQ is an offline emergency communication app that works without the internet, Wi-Fi, or servers. It uses Bluetooth mesh networking so nearby phones can relay messages over multiple hops, extending communication beyond direct Bluetooth range.

The app also lets users send SOS alerts with their location, share updates with nearby people, and use an on-device AI assistant that works completely offline. By combining offline messaging, shared coordination, and local AI, ResQ helps rescue teams, volunteers, trekkers, and communities stay connected when traditional communication fails.

**Challenges we ran into**

Our project implements the BitChat protocol for BLE mesh networking and layers Yjs CRDT on top to provide collaborative state synchronization.

BLE has a maximum payload size per packet determined by the negotiated MTU. A Yjs update can be significantly larger than that limit. To transport it reliably over BLE, we fragment each serialized Yjs update into multiple packets. Each fragment carries metadata . The receiving device buffers the fragments, reassembles them in the correct order, verifies that all fragments have arrived, reconstructs the original Yjs update, and then applies it to the local CRDT document.

A practical challenge was that serialized Yjs updates frequently exceeded the maximum BLE payload size. Large updates could not be transmitted in a single BLE packet, so we implemented an application-layer fragmentation protocol. Each update is divided into multiple numbered fragments that fit within the BLE payload limit.

Fragmentation alone was insufficient because losing even a single fragment made the entire CRDT update unusable. To address this, we implemented an asynchronous reliability layer on top of BLE. Every transmitted fragment is acknowledged by the receiver. Missing acknowledgements trigger selective retransmission of only the lost fragments rather than the entire update. Once all fragments are received, they are reassembled into the original Yjs update and applied to the local CRDT document. This ensures reliable synchronization even in lossy BLE mesh environments.

**Open Innovation**

ResQ addresses a real-world problem that affects disaster response, remote travel, and emergency situations where internet and cellular networks are unavailable. Instead of relying on existing communication infrastructure, it creates a decentralized Bluetooth mesh network that allows nearby devices to relay messages without servers or the internet.

The project combines multiple technologies including Bluetooth Low Energy mesh networking, CRDT-based offline synchronization, secure identity management, GPS location sharing, and on-device AI to build a practical emergency communication platform. This integration enables users to communicate, coordinate rescue efforts, share locations, and access AI assistance entirely offline.

By rethinking how emergency communication works in disconnected environments, ResQ provides an innovative solution that can be applied across disaster management, humanitarian response, outdoor safety, and community resilience, making it a strong fit for the Open Innovation track.

### The Solution

**Real-Time Scene Narrator** turns a phone camera into a live, spoken description of the world — combining fast on-device object detection with deep AI scene understanding, so users get both instant hazard alerts and rich contextual narration, spoken back to them naturally.

---

### What People Can Use It For

**1. Safe Independent Navigation**
- Walking on sidewalks, campuses, or unfamiliar streets with real-time alerts on approaching people, bikes, or vehicles — including how far away they are ("car, about 2 meters ahead").
- Reduces reliance on a sighted companion for routine outdoor movement.

**2. Reading the World Around Them**
- Point the camera at a street sign, store name, room number, or printed menu and get it read aloud instantly — no need to locate someone to ask.
- Useful for transit stops, building directories, restaurant menus, medication labels, and mail.

**3. Understanding a New Space**
- Walking into an unfamiliar room, office, or store, the system describes the general layout — furniture placement, doorways, people present — giving spatial orientation that a cane alone can't provide.

**4. Hazard Avoidance in Real Time**
- Ambient mode continuously scans for fast-approaching hazards, prioritizing urgent warnings (vehicle/danger) over lower-priority ones (a stationary chair), so the user isn't overwhelmed by noise — just the alerts that matter, when they matter.

**5. Everyday Micro-Independence**
- Small but meaningful tasks: identifying if a seat is free, checking if a door is open or closed, confirming which bus has pulled up, or finding a dropped item — all without needing to ask for help.

---

### How It Makes Things Easier and Safer

| Existing Challenge | How the Narrator Helps |
|---|---|
| Canes/dogs detect *that* something is there, not *what* it is | AI identifies the object class (bike, car, person, obstacle) and speaks it out |
| No way to judge distance to a hazard | Monocular distance estimation gives a spoken metric distance, not just a beep |
| Reading text requires sighted help or a static scanner app | Point-and-read OCR narration works live, in motion |
| Generic screen readers overload users with long text | Prioritized, cooldown-filtered speech avoids repetition and cognitive overload — urgent things are said first and clearly |
| Cloud-only AI apps fail offline or lag | Hybrid design: fast local detection (~350ms) for safety-critical alerts, richer cloud AI for detailed scene description, with offline speech fallback if network drops |

---

### Core Value in One Line
It gives blind and visually impaired users a fast, prioritized, spoken second set of eyes — turning "there's something ahead" into "a bicycle is 2 meters ahead and closing," and "I can't read this" into "the sign says Platform 3."

**The problem it solves**

## Real-Time Scene Narrator — Refined Solution Overview

### The Problem

Blind and visually impaired individuals face a persistent gap between the mobility tools they have (canes, guide dogs) and the information they actually need. A cane can find a curb, but it can't tell you a cyclist is approaching from the side. A guide dog can avoid a pole, but it can't read the "Room 204" sign on the door in front of you. This leaves people dependent on sighted companions or clunky screen-reader apps for everyday tasks that sighted people take for granted — crossing a street safely, finding a storefront, reading a menu, or knowing who and what is around them in a new space.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

### 🌟 1. Google Gemini API (Multimodal Vision & OCR)
* **Role in Project**: Serves as the **"Cognitive Visual Brain"** of VisionMate.
* **Best Use Cases**:
  1. **Rich Scene Narration**: Converts live camera frames into concise, 1–2 sentence spatial descriptions of surrounding environments (furniture layout, pathways, obstacles) via `gemini-2.5-flash`.
  2. **OCR & Text/Address Extraction (Task Mode)**: Instantly reads text from street signs, documents, and packaging, while automatically parsing addresses to auto-fill turn-by-turn GPS routing.
  3. **High-Accuracy Cloud Fallback**: Provides deep contextual understanding when local edge object detection requires richer environmental analysis.

**Best Use of ElevenLabs**

### 🎙️ 2. ElevenLabs API (Ultra-Realistic Text-to-Speech Engine)
* **Role in Project**: Serves as the **"Human Voice Assistant"** for visually impaired users.
* **Best Use Cases**:
  1. **Human-Grade Voice Narration**: Converts AI scene summaries into natural, ultra-realistic human speech using the low-latency **ElevenLabs Turbo v2** engine.
  2. **Directional & Medical Emergency Cueing**: Delivers crystal-clear voice instructions for GPS navigation and critical audio alarms for the **3-minute idle medical emergency tracker**.
  3. **Reduced Cognitive Fatigue**: Natural vocal inflections dramatically improve listening comfort and comprehension for visually impaired users receiving continuous audio feedback throughout the day.

**Open Innovation**

Edited open_innovation_pitch.md

Here is why **VisionMate (Real-Time Scene Narrator)** is a standout fit for the **Open Innovation** category:

---

### 1. 🌐 Open-Source & Standard-Based Ecosystem
- **Zero Proprietary Walled Gardens**: Uses **OpenStreetMap (Nominatim)** for geocoding and **OSRM** for turn-by-turn routing — completely free, open-source, and keyless.
- **Hardware-Agnostic Accessibility**: Operates directly in web browsers on laptops, webcams, smartphones, or virtual lenses (Camo Studio/OBS), eliminating the need for expensive, proprietary $2,000+ assistive gadgets.

---

### 2. 🧩 Community Extensibility & Dataset Flexibility (`train_model.py` & `ai_inference.py`)
- **Kaggle Co-Creation**: `train_model.py` features automated `kagglehub` integration. Any developer or researcher worldwide can plug in custom datasets (COCO, Open Images, FER2013) to adapt VisionMate for hospital navigation, crosswalk safety, or workplace hazard detection.
- **Single-Line Integration Engine**: `ai_inference.py` exposes clean APIs (`detect_objects`, `analyze_surroundings`, `gps_navigation_hook`, `detect_mood_and_emergency`). Smart glass creators, robotics teams, or IoT developers can import VisionMate's perception engine with a single line of Python code.

---

### 3. ⚡ Edge-to-Cloud Hybrid Resilience
- **Graceful Fallback**: Dynamically operates offline on low-power edge hardware using local fine-tuned **YOLOv8 Nano**, while seamlessly upgrading to cloud multimodal intelligence (**Google Gemini 2.5 Flash**) when online. Visually impaired users stay protected even in low-connectivity environments.

---

### 4. 🚨 Multi-Domain Convergence: Medical Emergency Safety Net
- **Posture & Unresponsiveness Tracking**: Fuses assistive computer vision with passive medical safety. If a user is detected sitting idle and unresponsive for **over 3 minutes (180s)**, it automatically triggers a **CRITICAL MEDICAL EMERGENCY** alert.

**The Problem**
Compliance teams at SMEs have to manually check every customer's onboarding documents and transaction history for red flags — expired IDs, mismatched data, suspicious payments. It's slow, inconsistent between reviewers, and prone to alert fatigue, where tired reviewers miss the things that actually matter.
The AI tools that exist to speed this up mostly run in the cloud, which means sending sensitive KYC and financial data off-premise — a privacy and regulatory risk in itself for a financial institution. And even when a tool does flag something, it usually stops at "this looks risky," leaving the compliance officer to figure out what to actually do about it.
In one line: SMEs need compliance review that's fast, private, and actionable — and today's options force a tradeoff between those three that shouldn't have to exist.
**ClearCheck AI removes that tradeoff:**
1.Deterministic rule checks catch what's provable
2.Gemma reasons about what needs judgment
3.Everything runs locally — no data ever leaves the machine
4.Every flag comes with a concrete fix, not just a red flag

### Auto Blogger
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/auto-blogger-1851) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/md-neyab/hackathon-1-blog-automator) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://blog-automator-ten.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bx711VErztU) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MicroCraft%20--%20Vibeathon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://microcraft-vibeathon.devfolio.co)

> AI Engine: Research, Write, Publish, and Index.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**Inspiration**
Every SaaS founder and local business needs organic traffic, but manual SEO is a nightmare. Researching keywords, writing content, sourcing images, publishing, and manually requesting indexing takes hours every week. Existing AI tools just act as wrappers where you still have to copy-paste prompts and manage active browser sessions. I wanted to build a true "set it and forget it" autonomous engine that handles the entire pipeline.

**What it does**
Auto-Blogger (NexusScribe) is a fully autonomous, BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) content marketing agent. You provide your Gemini and Pexels API keys, drop your product URLs, and the system takes over. It crawls your pages (intelligently handling Clerk auth walls by requesting manual descriptions instead of failing), generates highly contextual blogs, embeds relevant images, publishes directly to Notion or WordPress, and instantly pings the Google Indexing API. It runs entirely in the background with a strict limit of 2 posts per day to maintain natural, organic SEO growth.

**How i built it**
The frontend is built with Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, hosted on Vercel for a seamless, fast UI. For the database and secure key storage, we used Supabase. However, the core automation engine is decoupled. To bypass Vercel's serverless timeouts during heavy AI generation tasks, the background worker is built on Node.js/Express, hosted on Render, and triggered seamlessly by external cron-jobs.

**Challenges we ran into**
The biggest challenge was the classic serverless execution limit. Complex tasks involving web scraping, deep LLM reasoning, image fetching, and multi-CMS publishing constantly hit the 30-second timeout on Edge environments. We solved this by decoupling the architecture and moving the heavy lifting to Render. Another major issue was network failures during long API chains. We engineered a stateful execution system in Supabase—if the server drops at step 3, it logs the state and resumes exactly from step 3 on the next cron trigger without any data loss.

**Accomplishments that we're proud of**
Successfully engineering a fault-tolerant, stateful execution loop that completely removes the user from the equation after the initial setup. Getting the Google Cloud Auto-Indexing API to trigger the exact second a post goes live was a massive win for immediate SEO traction.

**What we learned**
We learned the critical differences between edge computing limitations and long-running background tasks. We also mastered handling multiple external APIs (Gemini, Pexels, WordPress, Notion, Google Cloud) simultaneously while ensuring database consistency through our custom stateful logging mechanism.

**What's next for Auto-Blogger**
The next step is scaling the architecture to handle thousands of concurrent campaigns without breaking a sweat, and adding direct integrations for auto-repurposing the generated blogs into highly engaging LinkedIn and X (Twitter) threads.

**The problem it solves**

Smart Device Freeze System is a security-focused application designed to protect user data in case of unauthorized access or hacking attempts. The app automatically detects suspicious activity on a device and instantly locks (freezes) the system to prevent data theft, misuse, or intrusion.

💡 Problem It Solves

In today’s digital world, devices can be compromised through:

Unauthorized login attempts
Malware or hacking attacks
Lost or stolen devices

Once access is gained, sensitive data (photos, passwords, banking info) can be easily misused.

🛠️ Solution

This app acts as a real-time defense system by:

Monitoring unusual activity (multiple failed logins, unknown access patterns)
Detecting potential security threats
Instantly freezing the device to block access
Preventing hackers from viewing or stealing data

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/edc1e335507d415ea6b1a74cb5bd5679/d73fbccf-7112-490a-bc07-f78062a7f2bd.png)

**Challenges we ran into**

While building the Smart Device Freeze System, I encountered several technical and practical challenges:

1.  Detecting Suspicious Activity
It was difficult to define what counts as “suspicious behavior” (e.g., multiple failed logins, unusual access patterns).
Solution: I implemented rule-based logic combined with threshold limits to trigger alerts and freeze actions reliably.

2.Real-time System Response
Ensuring the system reacts instantly to threats without delay was challenging.
Solution: Optimized backend logic and used efficient condition checks to trigger immediate device freeze actions.

3.Deployment Issues (Render + Flask)
While deploying the app, I faced issues like:
Missing dependencies
gunicorn errors
Environment variable setup
Solution:
Created a proper requirements.txt
Added gunicorn for production
Configured environment variables correctly in Render


These challenges helped improve problem-solving skills and resulted in a more secure, optimized, and production-ready application.

> Freelancing Without Fear.

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![Cloudinary](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cloudinary-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The Problem We’re Solving**

Freelancing has created amazing opportunities, but it still runs on one thing that’s often missing—trust.

Clients worry about fake profiles, AI-generated portfolios, and freelancers disappearing after receiving payments. On the other hand, freelancers struggle with delayed payments, unpaid invoices, changing project requirements, and clients who refuse to pay after work is completed.

Managing projects is also frustrating. Conversations are spread across emails and chats, milestones are unclear, and disputes become common.

TrustFlow AI is built to solve these problems by combining AI, biometric verification, and smart escrow technology into one secure platform.

How TrustFlow AI Works

**Verified Human Identity**

Instead of trusting a profile picture or resume, freelancers complete a live biometric verification with AI-powered liveness and deepfake detection.

This gives clients confidence that they’re working with a real, verified person—not a fake account or AI-generated identity.
**
Secure Escrow Payments**

Before work begins, clients deposit the agreed amount into a secure escrow wallet.

The money is safely locked and released only when approved milestones are completed, ensuring fairness for both sides.

*** Clients never lose money to unfinished work.
* Freelancers never have to chase payments.**

**AI Trust Score**

TrustFlow AI continuously evaluates each user’s reliability based on completed projects, payment history, communication, dispute records, and verification status.

Instead of relying on fake reviews, every freelancer and client earns a transparent AI Trust Score that reflects their real performance.

**AI Project Planner**

Not every client knows how to plan a software project.

They simply describe their idea—for example, “I need a mobile app for dog walkers”—and TrustFlow AI automatically creates a structured project plan with milestones, timelines, and estimated budgets.

This reduces confusion, prevents scope creep, and keeps both parties aligned from day one.

**Real-Time Collaboration**

Clients and freelancers can chat instantly, share files, negotiate milestones, and finalize agreements in one secure workspace.

Everything stays organized, transparent, and easy to track throughout the project.

**Why TrustFlow AI?**

TrustFlow AI removes the biggest barriers in freelancing—fraud, payment disputes, and lack of transparency.

By combining AI-powered verification, secure escrow payments, trust scoring, and intelligent project planning, it creates a safer and more reliable experience for both clients and freelancers.

Our vision is simple: to make online freelancing as trustworthy, transparent, and seamless as working with someone you already know.

**Challenges we ran into**

**🚧 Challenges We Ran Into**

Building TrustFlow AI within a limited hackathon timeline was challenging because we had to combine AI features, secure payments, real-time communication, and a modern web interface into one seamless platform.

**1. Building Real-Time Communication**

One of our biggest challenges was creating a smooth real-time chat experience for clients and freelancers. Keeping messages synchronized while maintaining a responsive UI required careful handling of WebSocket connections and application state.

We optimized our frontend state management and backend communication to ensure stable connections, instant updates, and a seamless user experience.
**
2. AI Identity Verification**

Implementing live identity verification was another major challenge. Capturing webcam input, processing image data efficiently, and securely sending it to the backend required handling media permissions, file uploads, and browser performance carefully.

We optimized the capture process to reduce unnecessary memory usage while ensuring reliable image transmission for verification.

**3. Backend Integration**

Since multiple modules—authentication, escrow, AI verification, chat, and project management—needed to communicate with each other, maintaining consistent API responses became important.

We standardized our API structure and data models so every frontend component received predictable and reliable data, making the application much more stable.

**4. Time Management**

The biggest challenge wasn’t just coding—it was building an ambitious product in a very short amount of time.

We divided responsibilities across frontend, backend, AI, and UI development, allowing the team to work in parallel. Continuous testing and integration helped us combine all modules into a working prototype before the deadline.

** What We Learned**

This project taught us how important clean architecture, teamwork, and planning are when building AI-powered applications. We also gained hands-on experience with real-time systems, secure workflows, API integration, and delivering a production-like solution under tight deadlines.

### Curiosity

> Your Smart AI Study Workspace

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Curiosity involved several technical challenges throughout development.

One of the biggest challenges was integrating multiple services while working entirely with free-tier resources. During development we faced API rate limits, deployment issues, authentication integration, database configuration, and backend hosting limitations.

Another challenge was creating a responsive user experience while maintaining a clean architecture between the frontend, backend, authentication system, and database.

Deploying on Render required debugging cold starts, server behavior, and production configuration. Managing PostgreSQL with Neon and keeping database operations reliable also required several iterations.

Throughout the project, every challenge became an opportunity to learn more about full-stack development, cloud deployment, authentication, database management, and AI integration.

Despite these obstacles, Curiosity evolved into a fully working application with secure authentication, persistent chat history, project organization, and AI-powered conversations.

**The problem it solves**

# The Problem

Students today use multiple disconnected tools for learning. They chat with AI on one platform, keep notes somewhere else, manage projects separately, and often lose valuable conversations because they are difficult to organize or revisit.

Most AI chatbots answer questions well, but they do not provide a structured workspace where students can continuously build knowledge over time.

This results in:
- Scattered learning resources
- Difficulty managing different subjects or projects
- Repetitive conversations with AI
- Poor organization of important information

# Our Solution

Curiosity is an AI-powered learning workspace built specifically for students.

Instead of being only an AI chatbot, Curiosity combines intelligent conversations with project organization, allowing students to manage different learning topics inside a single platform.

Users can:
- Chat with AI for learning and problem solving
- Organize discussions into projects
- Access previous conversations anytime
- Learn through a clean and distraction-free interface
- Securely access their own workspace using Google Authentication

Curiosity aims to make AI not just a tool for answering questions, but a long-term learning companion that helps students study more effective.

### Vibeshare
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/universalbridge-fb80) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vaishnavmahla/universal-bridge) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://vibeshare-two.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/nONTQAoubSc) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-MicroCraft%20--%20Vibeathon-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://microcraft-vibeathon.devfolio.co)

> Frictionless P2P data streaming across any device.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebRTC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebRTC-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Moving text, code snippets, or large files between a PC and a mobile device is painfully clunky. Currently, users are forced to email themselves, leave data traces on cloud drives (like Google Drive), or rely on ecosystem-locked tools like Apple AirDrop.

VibeShare shatters the ecosystem barrier. It provides a universal, zero-login, browser-native bridge. By leveraging WebRTC Data Channels, it streams files and clipboard data directly hardware-to-hardware.

Zero Cloud Storage: Files never touch a database.

Instant Clipboard Sync: Copy on your phone, and it instantly injects into your PC's clipboard cache.

Session Security: Workspaces are ephemeral and guarded by a custom Master Passcode matrix.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a real-time P2P engine across different operating systems brought up several strict browser security challenges:

1. Mobile Clipboard Sandboxing: Mobile browsers strictly block automatic clipboard reading (like a global Ctrl+V listener) to prevent malicious scraping. Solution: I engineered a native "Inject Field" UI component that explicitly triggers the mobile browser's Clipboard API, allowing safe, user-consented data transfer into the socket stream.

2. Cryptographic Secure Contexts:
The native window.crypto API requires a strict secure context (HTTPS). During local network testing over IP, mobile browsers blocked the encryption layer. Solution: I migrated the socket signaling bridge to a cloud Render instance and deployed the Vite frontend to Vercel. This forced a production SSL certificate, natively unlocking the browser's crypto capabilities and allowing Google STUN servers to route the WebRTC traffic globally.

3. Maintaining UI Integrity with Live Data:
Creating a rigid, cyberpunk-style dashboard is difficult when streaming live, unpredictable text payloads. Solution: I implemented strict CSS Flexbox boundaries with custom webkit scrollbars to ensure the terminal layout remains pixel-perfect regardless of data load.

> Smart receipt scanning with AI-powered pantry mana

![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Artificial Intelligence](https://img.shields.io/badge/Artificial%20Intelligence-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![apscheduler](https://img.shields.io/badge/apscheduler-333333?style=flat-square) ![API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-333333?style=flat-square) ![OCR Processing](https://img.shields.io/badge/OCR%20Processing-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SmartPantry addresses the common problem of food waste and manual pantry management by leveraging AI to automate grocery organization.

### It helps users by:

*  Automatically scanning and extracting grocery items from shopping receipts using AI.
*  Creating a digital pantry without requiring manual data entry.
*  Estimating product expiry dates based on the type of grocery item.
*  Sending timely email reminders before products expire.
*  Helping reduce food waste by encouraging users to consume items before they spoil.
*  Keeping a complete history of uploaded receipts for future reference.
*  Saving time and effort by eliminating manual inventory management.
*  Providing secure user authentication so every user has a private pantry.
*  Promoting smarter grocery planning and more sustainable food consumption.

**Challenges we ran into**

During development, I encountered several technical challenges that required careful problem-solving.

### Major challenges included:

*  **Receipt Parsing:** Receipts come in different layouts, fonts, and image qualities, making accurate product extraction difficult.
*  **AI Integration:** Integrating Google Gemini API and converting its responses into structured product data required multiple iterations.
*  **Expiry Prediction:** Since receipts usually don't contain expiry dates, I developed logic to estimate realistic shelf lives based on product categories.
*  **Reminder Automation:** Implementing background jobs to automatically check expiry dates and send email notifications without affecting application performance.
*  **Database Design:** Organizing users, receipts, and pantry items efficiently while maintaining proper relationships in MongoDB.
*  **Authentication:** Securing user accounts with JWT authentication and ensuring users only access their own pantry data.
*  **Performance:** Optimizing API responses and reducing unnecessary processing during receipt uploads.
*  **User Experience:** Designing a clean, responsive interface that makes receipt uploading and pantry management simple and intuitive.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

Building an AI-powered study platform involved several technical and design challenges.

1. Integrating Multiple AI Features
Our platform includes note generation, doubt solving, PDF summarization, quiz generation, and answer generation. Connecting these features while maintaining a consistent user experience required careful planning of the application flow and backend architecture.

 2. Managing AI Response Quality
Initially, AI responses were either too lengthy or lacked structure. We refined our prompts and response formatting to generate concise notes, well-structured explanations, and exam-oriented 5-mark and 10-mark answers.

 3. Authentication and User Data
Implementing secure user authentication and storing personalized data such as notes, quizzes, and progress was challenging. We used Firebase Authentication and Firestore to securely manage user accounts and cloud data.

 4. Handling PDF Processing
Extracting text from uploaded PDFs and generating meaningful summaries required handling different document formats and cleaning extracted text before sending it to the AI model.

 5. Designing a Student-Friendly UI
One of our biggest goals was to make the platform simple enough for any student to use. We redesigned several pages to reduce clutter, improve navigation, and ensure all major features were easily accessible from the dashboard.

### 6. Integrating Multiple Technologies
Connecting the frontend, Firebase services, AI APIs, and document processing modules introduced compatibility and debugging challenges. We resolved these by testing each module independently before integrating them into the final application.

How We Overcame These Challenges

- Broke the project into independent modules and developed them incrementally.
- Improved AI prompts through multiple rounds of testing.
- Used Firebase Authentication and Firestore for secure and reliable data management.
- Optimized PDF text extraction before AI processing.
- Conducted continuous testing and debugging after integrating each feature.
- Gathered feedback from teammates to improve usability and overall user experience.

**The problem it solves**

Students spend a significant amount of time searching for study materials, understanding complex concepts, creating notes, preparing for exams, and clearing doubts. Most learning resources are scattered across different websites, making studying time-consuming and inefficient.

Our AI Study Assistant Platform brings all essential study tools into one place, helping students learn faster and more effectively.

 It can be used for:

- Generating concise study notes from lengthy topics.
- Getting instant AI-powered doubt resolution instead of searching multiple websites.
- Creating 5-mark and 10-mark exam answers based on the syllabus.
- Summarizing PDFs and documents into easy-to-understand notes.
- Preparing for exams with quizzes, flashcards, and important questions.
- Planning study schedules and tracking learning progress.

 How it makes studying easier
- Saves hours of manual note-making.
- Reduces the need to switch between multiple apps and websites.
- Provides personalized learning assistance available 24/7.
- Helps students understand difficult topics with AI-generated explanations.

Our platform acts as an intelligent study companion that simplifies learning, boosts productivity, and helps students achieve better academic performance.

### CyberArena
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/cyberarena-5f5b) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/NINJA981/CyberArena) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://cyberarena-live.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/emKVcpSKsUs) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Tech%20Genesis%20'26-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://tech-genesis.devfolio.co)

> Experience Cyber Attacks Before They Reach Product

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![GraphQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/GraphQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Most developers use security tools that tell them *what* is vulnerable, but not *what happens next*.

Finding a vulnerable API or misconfigured service is only one part of the problem. It's much harder to understand how an attacker could use those weaknesses to move through an application and compromise critical systems.

CyberArena was built to bridge that gap.

Instead of giving developers another static vulnerability report, CyberArena creates an interactive simulation where they can watch attacks unfold across a virtual version of their application. They can inspect affected services, see how defensive actions change the outcome, and replay the entire incident to better understand what actually happened.

Our goal isn't to replace existing security scanners. It's to help developers and security teams understand the impact of vulnerabilities in a way that's visual, interactive, and much easier to learn from.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was making the simulation feel believable without making it overly complicated.

Our first idea relied heavily on AI for every attack decision, but it quickly became expensive, slow, and difficult to keep consistent. We eventually redesigned the system around a deterministic simulation engine, which made the results much faster and easier to reproduce.

Another challenge was the network visualization. Showing an entire application's infrastructure without overwhelming the user took several design iterations. We kept simplifying the layout until it felt more like a real security dashboard than a collection of random nodes.

Keeping the network view, timeline, agent activity, replay system, and analytics perfectly in sync was another challenge. We solved this by driving everything from the same simulation state, so every event updates across the platform consistently.

Most of our time was spent polishing the overall experience making the simulation easy to follow, keeping the interface clean, and ensuring every interaction felt connected.

Team **The Team** -- Ananya Harish, [Sai Charan](https://github.com/NINJA981)

> “Your Work, Your Identity, Your Dignity.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Sites API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Sites%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Handling multi‑lingual voice input across diverse dialects and accents.
2. Converting unstructured spoken logs into clean, structured database records.
3. Firebase authentication errors (auth/operation-not-allowed) during login/registration.
4. SPA routing issues on Netlify causing 404 errors on page refresh.
5. Building trust in worker logs and verification with contractors.
6. Standardizing data to satisfy financial partners for loans and insurance integration.

**The problem it solves**

India’s informal labor ecosystem, comprising over 400 million blue-collar workers, faces systemic challenges that keep them excluded from the formal economy and vulnerable to exploitation.

1. Invisible Work History

Issue: Workers have no formal records of employment; their daily labor remains undocumented.

How we solve: Karmika Setu’s AI Voice Log Ledger converts spoken logs into structured, verified digital records → building a visible, trusted work history.

2. Exclusion from Banking

Issue: No verifiable income means workers are denied access to loans and insurance, forcing them into debt traps with moneylenders.

How we solve: Verified logs generate a Karmika Trust Score, unlocking low‑interest micro‑loans (1.5% monthly) and affordable insurance directly through the platform.

3. Literacy & Language Barrier

Issue: Existing apps demand English typing and structured form‑filling, which most workers cannot manage.

How we solve: AI Voice Scribe lets workers simply speak in their native tongue; Gemini AI transcribes and translates into clean database entries.

4. Sourcing Inefficiencies

Issue: Contractors struggle to find reliable, skilled labor, relying on costly sub‑contractor chains.

How we solve: Karmika Setu’s Workforce Dashboard and Verified Worker Search connect contractors directly to skilled, authenticated workers → reducing delays and costs.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20API-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem AreaPulse Solves

India files ****40 million civic complaints yearly**** — almost none get resolved. Citizens face ****15-field government forms**** and abandon. Officers drown in ****unsorted queues with no SLA enforcement****. NGOs have ****zero access to ground-level data****. AreaPulse fixes all three.

---

### ****For Citizens — 5 Second Reporting****

- ****AR Camera**** — point at pothole, AI classifies, GPS auto-captured, submitted in ****5 seconds****
- ****WhatsApp Bot**** — send photo via Twilio, ****no app, no account, no form****
- ****Map Tap**** — tap location, upload photo, done in ****30 seconds****

AI pipeline powered by ****Groq Llama-4-Scout 17B**** — classifies ****10 categories****, scores severity, filters spam, detects ****duplicates within 50m****, auto-routes to correct department. Citizens get ****WhatsApp notifications**** on every status change.

---

### ****For Government — AI-Powered Accountability****

- ****SLA timers**** — sewage ****24hrs****, water ****48hrs****, garbage ****72hrs****, potholes ****168hrs****
- ****Auto-escalation**** on SLA breach + ****crowd escalation**** at 25+ upvotes
- ****AI Triage**** — Groq summarizes queue and suggests priority order
- ****One-click status**** — open → acknowledged → in_progress → resolved
- Every update ****auto-pings citizen via WhatsApp****

---

### ****For NGOs — Civic Intelligence****

- ****AI recommendations**** — highest-impact neighbourhood for each NGO's focus area
- ****Opportunity discovery**** — top intervention zones sorted by unresolved issue count
- ****Commitment tracking**** — progress tracked against resolved issues

---

### ****Platform Features****

- ****Public Stats Dashboard**** — resolution rates, SLA breaches, department performance, ****no login needed****
- ****Community Board**** — area channels, citizen posts, alerts, reputation points
- ****AI Complaint Letter**** — formal letter + ****PDF export**** + ****email via Resend API****
- ****Live Map**** — MapTiler + Leaflet, severity pins, heatmap, filtering by tag and area
- ****Dual Database**** — Neon PostgreSQL + Firebase Firestore with 5-min TTL cache
- ****Auth**** — Google OAuth 2.0 + anonymous reporting
- ****Deployed live**** on Render with UptimeRobot monitoring

**Challenges we ran into**

### ****Challenges We Ran Into****

****Firebase Quota Exhaustion**** — Free tier ran out within hours during testing. We engineered a ****5-minute TTL read cache**** that reduced daily reads from 2,880 to 288. Added graceful 429 handling that serves from in-memory seed data and queues writes in background threads. Users never see an error.

****Duplicate Detection at Scale**** — Calculating Haversine distance between every incoming report and all existing issues was expensive. We bounded the search to a ****50m radius and 7-day window**** to keep it fast without missing real duplicates.

****SLA System Design**** — Different issue categories need different deadlines. We mapped ****Indian municipal norms**** (24hrs sewage, 48hrs water, 72hrs garbage, 168hrs potholes) and built countdown timers that auto-escalate on breach — capped at 5 escalations per API request to protect the database connection pool.

****WhatsApp EXIF GPS Extraction**** — WhatsApp strips EXIF metadata on some devices. We built ****fallback logic**** — if GPS is missing from the photo, the bot asks the user to share a location pin, or defaults to area centroid coordinates.

****Render Free Tier Cold Starts**** — Both services spin down after inactivity. ****UptimeRobot pinging every 5 minutes**** keeps them warm. We also hit persistent ****pip timeout errors**** during deployment because unpinned dependencies caused pip to backtrack through 40+ package versions. Fixed by pinning every dependency to exact versions.

****AR Camera Latency**** — Getting computer vision classification ****under 5 seconds**** on a mobile browser required optimising image compression before sending to the Groq API. Raw photos were 3-5MB — we compress to under 500KB before the API call.

****Neon Postgres Connection Drops**** — Render free tier and Neon serverless pooler reject persistent connection pools. We replaced pooling with ****per-request fresh connections**** using a context manager that opens, commits, and closes cleanly even on errors — with auto-retry on transient SSL drops.

> Turning Retail Data into Smart Business Decisions.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced was building an accurate and reliable AI demand forecasting system using limited retail datasets. Retail data is often inconsistent, noisy, and changes rapidly due to customer behavior, seasonal trends, and product popularity.

Initially, our prediction model produced unstable forecasts because the inventory and sales data were not properly normalized. Some products had missing entries while others had irregular sales patterns, which affected model accuracy.

To solve this, we:

* Cleaned and preprocessed the dataset carefully
* Implemented data normalization and filtering techniques
* Used historical trend analysis to improve prediction stability
* Optimized the ML pipeline to handle fluctuating retail patterns

Another major hurdle was maintaining real-time inventory synchronization between the frontend dashboard and backend database. During testing, inventory updates occasionally caused delayed or duplicate stock values.

We overcame this by:

* Using Firebase real-time database synchronization
* Implementing proper API validation and state management
* Creating optimized update handlers to avoid duplicate writes

We also faced UI/UX challenges while designing a dashboard that non-technical retailers could easily understand. We simplified the interface by focusing on visual analytics, alerts, and actionable recommendations instead of complex technical data.

These challenges helped us improve our understanding of scalable AI systems, real-time architecture, and user-centered product design.

**The problem it solves**

Retail businesses, especially small and medium retailers, often struggle with inventory mismanagement, product wastage, inaccurate demand forecasting, and lack of real-time business insights. Most stores still rely on manual tracking or basic software that only stores data but does not provide intelligent decision-making support.

This leads to several problems:

* Overstocking of low-demand products
* Stock shortages of high-demand products
* Expired or wasted inventory
* Revenue loss due to poor forecasting
* Lack of understanding of customer buying behavior
* Time-consuming manual management processes

ShelfMind AI solves these challenges by acting as an intelligent retail operating system powered by AI and predictive analytics.

The platform helps retailers:

* Predict future product demand using AI
* Receive smart restocking recommendations
* Track inventory in real time
* Detect products nearing expiry to reduce waste
* Analyze customer purchasing patterns
* Improve operational efficiency and profitability

Instead of reacting after losses occur, retailers can make proactive, data-driven decisions using ShelfMind AI.

The system makes retail management easier, smarter, and more efficient by automating complex analysis and converting raw retail data into actionable business insights.
